```python:Compliance_Monitoring_ZeroSheild/BACKEND/CMP/services.py
def _get_backup_file_id_google_drive(
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    auth: dict[str, Any],
    file_path: str,
) -> str | None:
    """
    Get backup file ID from Google Drive Backup Original Files folder.
    
    Args:
        connection: Connection details
        auth: Authentication credentials
        file_path: Original file path/name
        
    Returns:
        File ID of the backup file, or None if not found
    """
    from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
    from googleapiclient.discovery import build
    from CMP.utils.cloud_writer import (
        _get_or_create_backup_folder_google_drive,
        _find_backup_file_google_drive,
        BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME
    )
    
    try:
        folder_id = connection.get("folder_id", "root")
        client_id = auth.get("client_id")
        client_secret = auth.get("client_secret")
        refresh_token = auth.get("refresh_token")
        
        if not all([client_id, client_secret, refresh_token]):
            return None
        
        # Strip whitespace from refresh token
        refresh_token = refresh_token.strip().replace('\n', '').replace('\r', '')
        
        # Create credentials
        creds = Credentials(
            token=None,
            refresh_token=refresh_token,
            token_uri="https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
            client_id=client_id,
            client_secret=client_secret,
            scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive']
        )
        
        # Refresh token
        from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
        if not creds.valid:
            creds.refresh(Request())
        
        service = build("drive", "v3", credentials=creds)
        
        # Get or create backup folder
        backup_folder_id = _get_or_create_backup_folder_google_drive(
            service, folder_id, BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME
        )
        
        if not backup_folder_id:
            return None
        
        # Find backup file
        file_name = file_path.split("/")[-1] if "/" in file_path else file_path
        backup_file_id = _find_backup_file_google_drive(
            service, backup_folder_id, file_name
        )
        
        return backup_file_id
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error getting backup file ID from Google Drive: {e}")
        return None


def _check_backup_file_exists(
    provider: str,
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    auth: dict[str, Any],
    backup_file_path: str,
) -> bool:
    """Check if backup file exists in cloud storage."""
    try:
        if provider == "aws_s3":
            import boto3
            bucket_name = connection.get("bucket_name")
            s3_client = boto3.client(
                "s3",
                aws_access_key_id=auth.get("aws_access_key_id"),
                aws_secret_access_key=auth.get("aws_secret_access_key"),
                region_name=connection.get("region", "us-east-1"),
            )
            try:
                s3_client.head_object(Bucket=bucket_name, Key=backup_file_path)
                return True
            except:
                return False
                
        elif provider == "azure_blob":
            from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
            from azure.identity import ClientSecretCredential
            storage_account = connection.get("storage_account_name")
            container_name = connection.get("container_name")
            account_url = f"https://{storage_account}.blob.core.windows.net"
            credential = ClientSecretCredential(
                auth.get("azure_tenant_id"),
                auth.get("azure_client_id"),
                auth.get("azure_client_secret")
            )
            blob_service = BlobServiceClient(account_url=account_url, credential=credential)
            container_client = blob_service.get_container_client(container_name)
            blob_client = container_client.get_blob_client(backup_file_path)
            try:
                blob_client.get_blob_properties()
                return True
            except:
                return False
                
        elif provider == "gcp_storage":
            from google.cloud import storage
            from google.oauth2 import service_account
            import json
            bucket_name = connection.get("bucket_name")
            service_account_json = auth.get("gcp_service_account_json")
            if isinstance(service_account_json, str):
                credentials_info = json.loads(service_account_json)
            else:
                credentials_info = service_account_json
            credentials = service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_info(credentials_info)
            client = storage.Client(project=connection.get("project_id"), credentials=credentials)
            bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
            blob = bucket.blob(backup_file_path)
            return blob.exists()
            
        elif provider == "sftp":
            import paramiko
            import io
            host = connection.get("host")
            port = connection.get("port", 22)
            username = auth.get("username")
            password = auth.get("password")
            private_key = auth.get("private_key")
            ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
            ssh.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
            if private_key:
                key = paramiko.RSAKey.from_private_key(io.StringIO(private_key))
                ssh.connect(hostname=host, port=port, username=username, pkey=key)
            else:
                ssh.connect(hostname=host, port=port, username=username, password=password)
            sftp = ssh.open_sftp()
            try:
                sftp.stat(backup_file_path)
                sftp.close()
                ssh.close()
                return True
            except:
                sftp.close()
                ssh.close()
                return False
        else:
            return False
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error checking backup file existence: {e}")
        return False
```

**Summary:**

1. Google Drive backup folder: `_get_or_create_backup_folder_google_drive` creates/gets the "Backup Original Files" folder
2. Backup file lookup: `_find_backup_file_google_drive` finds files by name in the backup folder
3. Remasking: `_get_backup_file_id_google_drive` retrieves the backup file ID for remasking
4. Download: `_download_from_google_drive` accepts file IDs or file names
5. Upload: `_upload_to_google_drive` stores backups in the backup folder and returns the file ID

This handles Google Drive's file ID system while keeping the backup folder approach consistent across providers.

```python
// ... existing code at the top ...

BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME = "Backup Original Files"

def _get_backup_folder_path(original_path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """
    Get the backup folder path for a given original file path.
    
    Args:
        original_path: Original file path
        
    Returns:
        Tuple of (backup_file_path, backup_folder_path)
    """
    import os
    # Extract directory and filename
    dir_path = os.path.dirname(original_path) or ""
    file_name = os.path.basename(original_path)
    
    # Create backup folder path
    if dir_path:
        backup_folder = os.path.join(dir_path, BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME).replace("\\", "/")
    else:
        backup_folder = BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME
    
    # Backup file path
    backup_file_path = os.path.join(backup_folder, file_name).replace("\\", "/")
    return backup_file_path, backup_folder


def _get_or_create_backup_folder_google_drive(
    service,
    parent_folder_id: str,
    folder_name: str = BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME
) -> str | None:
    """
    Get or create backup folder in Google Drive.
    
    Args:
        service: Google Drive service object
        parent_folder_id: Parent folder ID where backup folder should be created
        folder_name: Name of the backup folder (default: "Backup Original Files")
        
    Returns:
        Folder ID of the backup folder, or None if error
    """
    try:
        # Check if folder already exists
        query = (
            f"name='{folder_name}' and "
            f"'{parent_folder_id}' in parents and "
            f"mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and "
            f"trashed=false"
        )
        folders = service.files().list(q=query, fields="files(id, name)").execute()
        
        if folders.get("files"):
            return folders["files"][0]["id"]
        
        # Create folder
        folder_metadata = {
            "name": folder_name,
            "mimeType": "application/vnd.google-apps.folder",
            "parents": [parent_folder_id]
        }
        folder = service.files().create(body=folder_metadata, fields="id").execute()
        logger.info(f"Created backup folder '{folder_name}' in Google Drive")
        return folder.get("id")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error creating backup folder in Google Drive: {e}")
        return None


def _find_backup_file_google_drive(
    service,
    backup_folder_id: str,
    file_name: str
) -> str | None:
    """
    Find backup file in Google Drive backup folder.
    
    Args:
        service: Google Drive service object
        backup_folder_id: Backup folder ID
        file_name: Name of the file to find
        
    Returns:
        File ID of the backup file, or None if not found
    """
    try:
        query = (
            f"name='{file_name}' and "
            f"'{backup_folder_id}' in parents and "
            f"trashed=false"
        )
        files = service.files().list(q=query, fields="files(id, name)").execute()
        
        if files.get("files"):
            return files["files"][0]["id"]
        return None
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error finding backup file in Google Drive: {e}")
        return None

def _upload_to_google_drive(
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    auth: dict[str, Any],
    original_path: str,
    anonymized_content: bytes,
    mode: str,
    create_backup: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Upload anonymized file to Google Drive."""
    from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
    from googleapiclient.discovery import build
    from googleapiclient.http import MediaIoBaseUpload
    import io

    folder_id = connection.get("folder_id", "root")
    client_id = auth.get("client_id")
    client_secret = auth.get("client_secret")
    refresh_token = auth.get("refresh_token")

    if not all([client_id, client_secret, refresh_token]):
        return {"success": False, "error": "Missing required Google Drive OAuth credentials"}

    try:
        # Strip whitespace and newlines from refresh token
        refresh_token = refresh_token.strip().replace('\n', '').replace('\r', '')
        
        # Create credentials
        creds = Credentials(
            token=None,
            refresh_token=refresh_token,
            token_uri="https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
            client_id=client_id,
            client_secret=client_secret,
            scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive']
        )
        
        # Refresh the token
        from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
        from google.auth.exceptions import RefreshError
        try:
            if not creds.valid:
                creds.refresh(Request())
        except RefreshError as refresh_err:
            error_msg = str(refresh_err)
            logger.error(f"Token refresh failed during upload: {error_msg}")
            return {"success": False, "error": f"Token refresh failed: {error_msg}"}

        service = build("drive", "v3", credentials=creds)

        # Find file by name (original_path is the file name in Google Drive)
        file_name = original_path.split("/")[-1] if "/" in original_path else original_path
        query = f"name='{file_name}' and '{folder_id}' in parents and trashed=false"
        files = service.files().list(q=query, fields="files(id, name)").execute()

        backup_file_id = None
        if create_backup and mode == "replace" and files.get("files"):
            # Get or create backup folder
            backup_folder_id = _get_or_create_backup_folder_google_drive(
                service, folder_id, BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME
            )
            
            if backup_folder_id:
                original_file_id = files["files"][0]["id"]
                
                # Check if backup already exists in backup folder
                existing_backup_id = _find_backup_file_google_drive(
                    service, backup_folder_id, file_name
                )
                
                if existing_backup_id:
                    # Backup already exists, use it
                    backup_file_id = existing_backup_id
                    logger.info(f"Backup file already exists in Backup Original Files folder: {file_name}")
                else:
                    # Create backup by copying original file to backup folder
                    try:
                        copied_file = {
                            "name": file_name,
                            "parents": [backup_folder_id],
                        }
                        backup_file = service.files().copy(
                            fileId=original_file_id,
                            body=copied_file
                        ).execute()
                        backup_file_id = backup_file.get("id")
                        logger.info(f"Created backup in Backup Original Files folder: {file_name}")
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.warning(f"Failed to create backup: {e}")
            else:
                logger.warning("Failed to get or create backup folder in Google Drive")

        # Upload anonymized content
        if files.get("files"):
            # Update existing file
            file_id = files["files"][0]["id"]
            file_metadata = {"name": file_name}
            media = MediaIoBaseUpload(
                io.BytesIO(anonymized_content),
                mimetype="application/octet-stream",
                resumable=True
            )
            service.files().update(
                fileId=file_id,
                body=file_metadata,
                media_body=media
            ).execute()
        else:
            # Create new file
            file_metadata = {"name": file_name, "parents": [folder_id]}
            media = MediaIoBaseUpload(
                io.BytesIO(anonymized_content),
                mimetype="application/octet-stream",
                resumable=True
            )
            service.files().create(
                body=file_metadata,
                media_body=media,
                fields="id"
            ).execute()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "new_path": original_path,
            "backup_path": backup_file_id,  # This is a file ID for Google Drive
            "backup_folder_id": backup_folder_id if create_backup and mode == "replace" else None,
            "provider": "google_drive",
        }

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Google Drive upload error: {e}")
        return {"success": False, "error": str(e)}
```

```python
def download_file_from_cloud(
    provider: str,
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    auth: dict[str, Any],
    file_path: str,
) -> bytes | None:
    """
    Download file from cloud storage for re-processing.
    
    For Google Drive, file_path can be either:
    - A file name (to search in the folder)
    - A file ID (direct download)

    Args:
        provider: Cloud provider
        connection: Connection details
        auth: Authentication credentials
        file_path: File path in cloud storage (or file ID for Google Drive)

    Returns:
        File content as bytes, or None if error
    """
    try:
        if provider == "aws_s3":
            return _download_from_s3(connection, auth, file_path)
        elif provider == "azure_blob":
            return _download_from_azure(connection, auth, file_path)
        elif provider == "gcp_storage":
            return _download_from_gcp(connection, auth, file_path)
        elif provider == "google_drive":
            return _download_from_google_drive(connection, auth, file_path)
        elif provider == "sftp":
            return _download_from_sftp(connection, auth, file_path)
        else:
            logger.error(f"Unsupported cloud provider: {provider}")
            return None

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error downloading from {provider}: {e}", exc_info=True)
        return None

def _download_from_google_drive(
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    auth: dict[str, Any],
    file_path_or_id: str,
) -> bytes | None:
    """
    Download file from Google Drive.
    
    Args:
        connection: Connection details
        auth: Authentication credentials
        file_path_or_id: File name (to search) or file ID (direct download)

    Returns:
        File content as bytes, or None if error
    """
    from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
    from googleapiclient.discovery import build
    from googleapiclient.http import MediaIoBaseDownload
    import io

    folder_id = connection.get("folder_id", "root")
    client_id = auth.get("client_id")
    client_secret = auth.get("client_secret")
    refresh_token = auth.get("refresh_token")

    if not all([client_id, client_secret, refresh_token]):
        return None

    try:
        # Strip whitespace and newlines from refresh token
        refresh_token = refresh_token.strip().replace('\n', '').replace('\r', '')
        
        # Create credentials
        creds = Credentials(
            token=None,
            refresh_token=refresh_token,
            token_uri="https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
            client_id=client_id,
            client_secret=client_secret,
            scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive']
        )
        
        # Refresh the token
        from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
        from google.auth.exceptions import RefreshError
        try:
            if not creds.valid:
                creds.refresh(Request())
        except RefreshError as refresh_err:
            logger.error(f"Token refresh failed during download: {refresh_err}")
            return None

        service = build("drive", "v3", credentials=creds)

        # Check if file_path_or_id is a file ID (typically 33 characters, alphanumeric)
        # or a file name
        file_id = None
        if len(file_path_or_id) > 20 and file_path_or_id.replace('-', '').replace('_', '').isalnum():
            # Likely a file ID, try direct download
            try:
                file_id = file_path_or_id
                request = service.files().get_media(fileId=file_id)
            except Exception:
                # Not a valid file ID, treat as file name
                file_id = None
        
        if not file_id:
            # Treat as file name, search for it
            file_name = file_path_or_id.split("/")[-1] if "/" in file_path_or_id else file_path_or_id
            query = f"name='{file_name}' and '{folder_id}' in parents and trashed=false"
            files = service.files().list(q=query, fields="files(id)").execute()

            if not files.get("files"):
                return None

            file_id = files["files"][0]["id"]

        # Download file by ID
        request = service.files().get_media(fileId=file_id)
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        downloader = MediaIoBaseDownload(buffer, request)
        done = False
        while not done:
            _, done = downloader.next_chunk()

        return buffer.getvalue()

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Google Drive download error: {e}")
        return None
```

```python
def _get_backup_file_id_google_drive(
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    auth: dict[str, Any],
    file_path: str,
) -> str | None:
    """
    Get backup file ID from Google Drive Backup Original Files folder.
    
    Args:
        connection: Connection details
        auth: Authentication credentials
        file_path: Original file path/name
        
    Returns:
        File ID of the backup file, or None if not found
    """
    from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
    from googleapiclient.discovery import build
    from CMP.utils.cloud_writer import (
        _get_or_create_backup_folder_google_drive,
        _find_backup_file_google_drive,
        BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME
    )
    
    try:
        folder_id = connection.get("folder_id", "root")
        client_id = auth.get("client_id")
        client_secret = auth.get("client_secret")
        refresh_token = auth.get("refresh_token")
        
        if not all([client_id, client_secret, refresh_token]):
            return None
        
        # Strip whitespace from refresh token
        refresh_token = refresh_token.strip().replace('\n', '').replace('\r', '')
        
        # Create credentials
        creds = Credentials(
            token=None,
            refresh_token=refresh_token,
            token_uri="https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
            client_id=client_id,
            client_secret=client_secret,
            scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive']
        )
        
        # Refresh token
        from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
        if not creds.valid:
            creds.refresh(Request())
        
        service = build("drive", "v3", credentials=creds)
        
        # Get or create backup folder
        backup_folder_id = _get_or_create_backup_folder_google_drive(
            service, folder_id, BACKUP_FOLDER_NAME
        )
        
        if not backup_folder_id:
            return None
        
        # Find backup file
        file_name = file_path.split("/")[-1] if "/" in file_path else file_path
        backup_file_id = _find_backup_file_google_drive(
            service, backup_folder_id, file_name
        )
        
        return backup_file_id
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error getting backup file ID from Google Drive: {e}")
        return None


def _check_backup_file_exists(
    provider: str,
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    auth: dict[str, Any],
    backup_file_path: str,
) -> bool:
    """Check if backup file exists in cloud storage."""
    try:
        if provider == "aws_s3":
            import boto3
            bucket_name = connection.get("bucket_name")
            s3_client = boto3.client(
                "s3",
                aws_access_key_id=auth.get("aws_access_key_id"),
                aws_secret_access_key=auth.get("aws_secret_access_key"),
                region_name=connection.get("region", "us-east-1"),
            )
            try:
                s3_client.head_object(Bucket=bucket_name, Key=backup_file_path)
                return True
            except:
                return False
                
        elif provider == "azure_blob":
            from azure.storage.blob import BlobServiceClient
            from azure.identity import ClientSecretCredential
            storage_account = connection.get("storage_account_name")
            container_name = connection.get("container_name")
            account_url = f"https://{storage_account}.blob.core.windows.net"
            credential = ClientSecretCredential(
                auth.get("azure_tenant_id"),
                auth.get("azure_client_id"),
                auth.get("azure_client_secret")
            )
            blob_service = BlobServiceClient(account_url=account_url, credential=credential)
            container_client = blob_service.get_container_client(container_name)
            blob_client = container_client.get_blob_client(backup_file_path)
            try:
                blob_client.get_blob_properties()
                return True
            except:
                return False
                
        elif provider == "gcp_storage":
            from google.cloud import storage
            from google.oauth2 import service_account
            import json
            bucket_name = connection.get("bucket_name")
            service_account_json = auth.get("gcp_service_account_json")
            if isinstance(service_account_json, str):
                credentials_info = json.loads(service_account_json)
            else:
                credentials_info = service_account_json
            credentials = service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_info(credentials_info)
            client = storage.Client(project=connection.get("project_id"), credentials=credentials)
            bucket = client.bucket(bucket_name)
            blob = bucket.blob(backup_file_path)
            return blob.exists()
            
        elif provider == "sftp":
            import paramiko
            import io
            host = connection.get("host")
            port = connection.get("port", 22)
            username = auth.get("username")
            password = auth.get("password")
            private_key = auth.get("private_key")
            ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
            ssh.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
            if private_key:
                key = paramiko.RSAKey.from_private_key(io.StringIO(private_key))
                ssh.connect(hostname=host, port=port, username=username, pkey=key)
            else:
                ssh.connect(hostname=host, port=port, username=username, password=password)
            sftp = ssh.open_sftp()
            try:
                sftp.stat(backup_file_path)
                sftp.close()
                ssh.close()
                return True
            except:
                sftp.close()
                ssh.close()
                return False
        else:
            return False
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error checking backup file existence: {e}")
        return False
```

Reviewing the exact implementation:


How risk levels are calculated in the PII Prevention module:

## Risk Level Calculation Process

### 1. Individual PII Instance Risk Score (0-100)

Each detected PII instance gets a `risk_score` calculated in `Compliance_Monitoring_ZeroSheild/BACKEND/CMP/utils/pii_detector.py`:

```python
def calculate_risk_score(pii_type: str, score: float, context: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> float:
    """
    Calculate risk score for a PII instance (0-100) with Indian risk tiers.
    """
    base_risks = {
        # High Risk PII Types (75+)
        "AADHAAR": 95.0,
        "PAN": 95.0,
        "INDIAN_CREDIT_CARD": 98.0,
        "CREDIT_CARD": 98.0,
        "SSN": 95.0,
        "INDIAN_BANK_ACCOUNT": 90.0,
        "INDIAN_PASSPORT": 90.0,
        "VOTER_ID": 85.0,
        "INDIAN_DRIVING_LICENSE": 85.0,
        "UAN": 85.0,
        "IFSC": 80.0,
        "RATION_CARD": 80.0,
        
        # Medium Risk PII Types (50-74)
        "INDIAN_MOBILE": 60.0,
        "EMAIL": 60.0,
        "PHONE": 55.0,
        "PERSON_NAME": 50.0,
        
        # Low Risk PII Types (<50)
        "IP_ADDRESS": 40.0,
        "LOCATION": 35.0,
        "DATE_TIME": 30.0,
        "ORGANIZATION": 25.0,
    }
    
    base_risk = base_risks.get(pii_type, 50.0)
    adjusted_risk = base_risk * score  # score is confidence (0-1)
    
    # Context adjustments
    if context:
        if context.get("sensitive_location"):
            adjusted_risk = min(100, adjusted_risk * 1.2)  # +20% for sensitive locations
        if context.get("public_data"):
            adjusted_risk = max(0, adjusted_risk * 0.7)  # -30% for public data
    
    return round(adjusted_risk, 2)
```

### 2. Risk Level Categorization

After scanning, instances are categorized in `Compliance_Monitoring_ZeroSheild/BACKEND/CMP/services.py`:

```python
# Categorize by risk level
high_risk = PIIInstance.objects.filter(
    scan=scan, risk_score__gte=Decimal("75.0")
).count()

medium_risk = PIIInstance.objects.filter(
    scan=scan,
    risk_score__gte=Decimal("50.0"),
    risk_score__lt=Decimal("75.0"),
).count()

low_risk = PIIInstance.objects.filter(
    scan=scan, risk_score__lt=Decimal("50.0")
).count()
```

### 3. Risk Level Thresholds

| Risk Level | Risk Score Range | Description |
|------------|------------------|-------------|
| **High Risk** | `≥ 75.0` | Critical PII like Aadhaar, PAN, Credit Cards, SSN |
| **Medium Risk** | `50.0 - 74.9` | Moderate PII like Email, Phone, Names |
| **Low Risk** | `< 50.0` | Less sensitive PII like IP Address, Location, Dates |

### 4. Average Risk Score Calculation

```python
avg_risk = total_risk / instances_created if instances_created > 0 else Decimal("0.0")
```

The average risk score is the mean of all individual risk scores.

## Summary

1. Each PII instance gets a risk score (0-100) based on:
   - PII type (base risk)
   - Detection confidence
   - Context (sensitive location increases risk, public data decreases it)

2. Instances are grouped into:
   - High Risk: score ≥ 75.0
   - Medium Risk: 50.0 ≤ score < 75.0
   - Low Risk: score < 50.0

3. The summary includes:
   - Counts per risk level
   - Average risk score (mean of all scores)

The frontend displays these counts and the average risk score from `scan.summary` in the Risk Summary section.

```python

        # High Risk PII Types (75+)

    }
    
    base_risk = base_risks.get(pii_type, 50.0)
    adjusted_risk = base_risk * score  # score is confidence (0-1)
    
    # Context adjustments
    if context:
        if context.get("sensitive_location"):
            adjusted_risk = min(100, adjusted_risk * 1.2)  # +20% for sensitive locations
        if context.get("public_data"):
```

```jsx:Compliance_Monitoring_ZeroSheild/FRONTEND/src/CreateBannerModal.jsx
  // Initialize form data with initialData if provided (for editing)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData && isOpen) {
      // Reset to Basic Information section when modal opens
      setActiveSection("basic");
      setVisitedSections(new Set(["basic"])); // Reset visited sections for editing
      // ... existing formData initialization ...
    } else if (!initialData && isOpen) {
      // Reset to Basic Information section when modal opens
      setActiveSection("basic");
      setVisitedSections(new Set(["basic"])); // Only basic section accessible initially
      // ... existing formData reset ...
    }
  }, [initialData, isOpen]);

  // ... existing handler functions ...

  const sections = [
    { id: "basic", label: "Basic Information", icon: FaShieldAlt },
    { id: "display", label: "Display Settings", icon: FaPalette },
    { id: "content", label: "Content", icon: FaAlignLeft },
    { id: "categories", label: "Privacy Categories", icon: FaCheckCircle },
    { id: "language", label: "Languages", icon: FaGlobe },
    { id: "advanced", label: "Advanced", icon: FaCog },
    // Only show Script Integration when editing an existing banner
    ...(initialData
      ? [{ id: "integration", label: "Script Integration", icon: FaCode }]
      : []),
  ];

  // Get current section index
  const currentSectionIndex = sections.findIndex(
    (s) => s.id === activeSection
  );
  const isLastSection = currentSectionIndex === sections.length - 1;
  const isCreating = !initialData;

  // Navigate to next section
  const handleNext = () => {
    if (currentSectionIndex < sections.length - 1) {
      const nextSection = sections[currentSectionIndex + 1];
      setActiveSection(nextSection.id);
      setVisitedSections((prev) => new Set([...prev, nextSection.id]));
    }
  };

  // Navigate to previous section
  const handlePrevious = () => {
    if (currentSectionIndex > 0) {
      const previousSection = sections[currentSectionIndex - 1];
      setActiveSection(previousSection.id);
    }
  };

  // Check if a section can be accessed (for creating new banners)
  const canAccessSection = (sectionId) => {
    if (!isCreating) return true; // When editing, all sections are accessible
    return visitedSections.has(sectionId);
  };

  // ... existing handleSave function ...

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 animate-fade-in"
      style={{ animation: "fadeIn 0.3s ease-out" }}
      aria-modal="true"
      role="dialog"
    >
      {/* ... existing styles ... */}
      
      <div
        className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl h-[90vh] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden transform transition-all duration-300 animate-fade-in"
        style={{ animation: "scaleIn 0.3s ease-out" }}
      >
        {/* ... existing header ... */}

        {/* Sidebar Navigation */}
        <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="w-64 bg-[#F9F7F7] border-r border-[#DBE2EF] flex-shrink-0 overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="p-4 space-y-2">
              {sections.map((section, idx) => {
                const Icon = section.icon;
                const canAccess = canAccessSection(section.id);
                const isActive = activeSection === section.id;
                
                return (
                  <button
                    key={section.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (canAccess) {
                        setActiveSection(section.id);
                        if (isCreating) {
                          setVisitedSections((prev) => new Set([...prev, section.id]));
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    disabled={!canAccess}
                    className={`w-full flex items-center space-x-3 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 text-left animate-fade-in font-semibold transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden group shadow-md ${
                      !canAccess
                        ? "bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 cursor-not-allowed opacity-50"
                        : isActive
                        ? "bg-[#3F72AF] text-white hover:bg-[#112D4E] hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/30"
                        : "bg-white text-[#112D4E] hover:bg-[#3F72AF] hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                    style={{
                      animation: `fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out ${idx * 0.1}s both`,
                    }}
                    title={!canAccess ? "Complete previous sections first" : ""}
                  >
                    <Icon size={16} className="relative z-10" />
                    <span className="text-sm relative z-10">
                      {section.label}
                    </span>
                    {!canAccess && isCreating && (
                      <span className="ml-auto text-xs">🔒</span>
                    )}
                    <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Main Content */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto bg-[#F9F7F7]">
            {/* ... existing section content (Basic, Display, Content, Categories, Language, Advanced, Integration) ... */}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div
          className="bg-[#F9F7F7] flex items-center justify-between px-10 py-4 border-t border-[#DBE2EF] space-x-3 flex-shrink-0 animate-fade-in"
          style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
        >
          {/* Previous Button - Show if not on first section */}
          {currentSectionIndex > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={handlePrevious}
              className="px-6 py-3 bg-white text-[#3F72AF] rounded-xl border border-[#3F72AF] hover:bg-[#3F72AF] hover:text-white shadow-md hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/30 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer font-semibold relative overflow-hidden group"
            >
              <span className="relative z-10">← Previous</span>
              <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Spacer to push buttons to the right when no Previous button */}
          {currentSectionIndex === 0 && <div></div>}

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-6 py-3 bg-white text-red-500 rounded-xl border border-red-500 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white shadow-md hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-red-500/30 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer font-semibold relative overflow-hidden group"
            >
              <span className="relative z-10">Cancel</span>
              <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
            </button>

            {/* Show Next button when creating and not on last section, or when editing and not on last section */}
            {!isLastSection && (
              <button
                onClick={handleNext}
                className="px-6 py-3 bg-[#3F72AF] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#112D4E] hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/30 font-semibold transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden group shadow-md"
              >
                <span className="relative z-10">Next →</span>
                <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Show Create/Update button only on last section when creating, or always when editing */}
            {(isLastSection || !isCreating) && (
              <button
                onClick={handleSave}
                className="px-6 py-3 bg-[#3F72AF] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#112D4E] hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/30 font-semibold transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden group shadow-md"
              >
                <span className="relative z-10">
                  {initialData ? "Update Banner" : "Create Banner"}
                </span>
                <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Summary of changes:**

1. Added `visitedSections` state to track accessible sections when creating.
2. Added `handleNext()` and `handlePrevious()` for navigation.
3. Added `canAccessSection()` to control access when creating.
4. Updated sidebar buttons to disable locked sections when creating.
5. Updated footer:
   - Show "Previous" when not on the first section.
   - Show "Next" when not on the last section.
   - Show "Create Banner" only on the last section when creating.
   - When editing, show "Update Banner" on all sections.
6. Visual indicator: locked sections show a lock icon when creating.

**Behavior:**
- Creating: sequential flow; "Create Banner" only on Advanced.
- Editing: all sections accessible; "Update Banner" always visible.

This enforces sequential completion for new banners while keeping editing flexible.
