```javascriptreact
// src/CreateBannerModal.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  FaTimes,
  FaPalette,
  FaAlignLeft,
  FaGlobe,
  FaCog,
  FaShieldAlt,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaTimesCircle,
  FaSlidersH,
  FaCode,
  FaCopy,
  FaCheck,
  FaEye,
  FaEyeSlash,
} from "react-icons/fa";
import { useAuth } from "./AuthContext";

export default function CreateBannerModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSave,
  initialData = null,
}) {
  const { user, fetchWithAuth } = useAuth();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    // Basic Information
    bannerName: "",
    description: "",

    // Display Settings
    displayStyle: "banner", // banner, modal
    position: "bottom", // top, bottom (for banner), top/center/bottom (for modal)
    theme: "blue", // blue, green, red, dark, custom
    customColor: "#9333EA", // Custom color for custom theme

    // Content Settings
    bannerTitle: "Privacy Settings",
    bannerMessage:
      "We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking 'Accept All', you consent to our use of cookies.",
    acceptButtonText: "Accept All",
    rejectButtonText: "Reject All",
    settingsButtonText: "Customize",
    showPrivacyPolicyLink: true,
    privacyPolicyUrl: "",

    // Privacy Categories
    categories: {
      necessary: { enabled: true, required: true, label: "Necessary Cookies" },
      analytics: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Analytics" },
      marketing: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Marketing" },
      personalization: {
        enabled: false,
        required: false,
        label: "Personalization",
      },
      functional: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Functional" },
      social: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Social Media" },
    },

    // Language Settings
    primaryLanguage: "en",
    additionalLanguages: [],

    // Advanced Settings
    showOnFirstVisitOnly: false,
    cookieExpiration: "365", // days
    autoHideDelay: "0", // seconds, 0 = don't auto-hide
    showRejectButton: true,
    showSettingsButton: true,
  });

  const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState("basic");
  const [visitedSections, setVisitedSections] = useState(new Set(["basic"])); // Track visited sections for new banners

  // API Key state
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState(null);
  const [apiKeyName, setApiKeyName] = useState("");
  const [loadingApiKey, setLoadingApiKey] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [showApiKey, setShowApiKey] = useState(false);

  // API Key management functions
  const fetchExistingAPIKey = async () => {
    if (!fetchWithAuth) return;

    try {
      setLoadingApiKey(true);
      const response = await fetchWithAuth("/api/cmp/api-keys/");
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.length > 0) {
          setApiKey(data[0]);
          setApiKeyName(data[0].name || "");
        } else {
          setApiKey(null);
          setApiKeyName("");
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch API key:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoadingApiKey(false);
    }
  };

  // Fetch existing API key when component opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && user?.organization && fetchWithAuth) {
      fetchExistingAPIKey();
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [isOpen, user?.organization]);

  // Initialize form data with initialData if provided (for editing)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData && isOpen) {
      // Reset to Basic Information section when modal opens
      setActiveSection("basic");
      setVisitedSections(new Set(["basic"])); // Reset visited sections for editing
      setFormData({
        bannerName: initialData.name || initialData.bannerName || "",
        description: initialData.description || "",
        displayStyle: initialData.displayStyle || "banner",
        position: initialData.position || "bottom",
        theme: initialData.theme || "blue",
        customColor: initialData.customColor || "#9333EA",
        bannerTitle: initialData.bannerTitle || "Privacy Settings",
        bannerMessage: initialData.bannerMessage || "",
        acceptButtonText: initialData.acceptButtonText || "Accept All",
        rejectButtonText: initialData.rejectButtonText || "Reject All",
        settingsButtonText: initialData.settingsButtonText || "Customize",
        showPrivacyPolicyLink: initialData.showPrivacyPolicyLink ?? true,
        privacyPolicyUrl: initialData.privacyPolicyUrl || "",
        categories: initialData.categories || {
          necessary: {
            enabled: true,
            required: true,
            label: "Necessary Cookies",
          },
          analytics: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Analytics" },
          marketing: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Marketing" },
          personalization: {
            enabled: false,
            required: false,
            label: "Personalization",
          },
          functional: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Functional" },
          social: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Social Media" },
        },
        primaryLanguage: initialData.primaryLanguage || "en",
        additionalLanguages: initialData.additionalLanguages || [],
        showOnFirstVisitOnly: initialData.showOnFirstVisitOnly || false,
        cookieExpiration: initialData.cookieExpiration || "365",
        autoHideDelay: initialData.autoHideDelay || "0",
        showRejectButton: initialData.showRejectButton ?? true,
        showSettingsButton: initialData.showSettingsButton ?? true,
      });
    } else if (!initialData && isOpen) {
      // Reset to Basic Information section when modal opens
      setActiveSection("basic");
      // Reset form when creating new banner
      setFormData({
        bannerName: "",
        description: "",
        displayStyle: "banner",
        position: "bottom",
        theme: "blue",
        customColor: "#9333EA",
        bannerTitle: "Privacy Settings",
        bannerMessage:
          "We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking 'Accept All', you consent to our use of cookies.",
        acceptButtonText: "Accept All",
        rejectButtonText: "Reject All",
        settingsButtonText: "Customize",
        showPrivacyPolicyLink: true,
        privacyPolicyUrl: "",
        categories: {
          necessary: {
            enabled: true,
            required: true,
            label: "Necessary Cookies",
          },
          analytics: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Analytics" },
          marketing: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Marketing" },
          personalization: {
            enabled: false,
            required: false,
            label: "Personalization",
          },
          functional: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Functional" },
          social: { enabled: false, required: false, label: "Social Media" },
        },
        primaryLanguage: "en",
        additionalLanguages: [],
        showOnFirstVisitOnly: false,
        cookieExpiration: "365",
        autoHideDelay: "0",
        showRejectButton: true,
        showSettingsButton: true,
      });
    }
  }, [initialData, isOpen]);

  const handleInputChange = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => {
      const newData = { ...prev, [field]: value };

      // When displayStyle changes, reset position if it's not valid for the new style
      if (field === "displayStyle") {
        if (value === "banner") {
          // Banner only supports top and bottom
          if (prev.position !== "top" && prev.position !== "bottom") {
            newData.position = "bottom";
          }
        } else if (value === "modal") {
          // Modal supports top, center, bottom - if current position is invalid, default to center
          if (
            prev.position !== "top" &&
            prev.position !== "center" &&
            prev.position !== "bottom"
          ) {
            newData.position = "center";
          }
        }
      }

      return newData;
    });
  };

  const handleCategoryChange = (category, field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      categories: {
        ...prev.categories,
        [category]: {
          ...prev.categories[category],
          [field]: value,
        },
      },
    }));
  };

  const handleLanguageToggle = (langCode) => {
    setFormData((prev) => {
      const isSelected = prev.additionalLanguages.includes(langCode);
      return {
        ...prev,
        additionalLanguages: isSelected
          ? prev.additionalLanguages.filter((l) => l !== langCode)
          : [...prev.additionalLanguages, langCode],
      };
    });
  };

  const generateAPIKey = async () => {
    if (!apiKeyName.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter a name for the API key.");
      return;
    }

    if (!fetchWithAuth) return;

    try {
      setLoadingApiKey(true);
      const response = await fetchWithAuth("/api/cmp/api-keys/", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: apiKeyName.trim(),
          is_active: true,
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setApiKey(data);
        alert("API key generated successfully!");
      } else {
        const error = await response.json();
        alert(
          `Failed to generate API key: ${
            error.error || error.detail || "Unknown error"
          }`
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to generate API key:", error);
      alert("Failed to generate API key. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setLoadingApiKey(false);
    }
  };

  const copyToClipboard = (text) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    });
  };

  // Get the API URL from VITE_API_URL environment variable
  const getAPIUrl = () => {
    // Use VITE_API_URL from environment (configured in vite.config.js)
    const apiUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL;

    if (apiUrl) {
      return apiUrl;
    }

    // Fallback: Try to get from window config
    if (window.CMP_CONFIG && window.CMP_CONFIG.API_URL) {
      return window.CMP_CONFIG.API_URL;
    }

    // Final fallback (should not be needed if VITE_API_URL is set)
    return "http://127.0.0.1:8000";
  };

  // Generate the integration script
  const getIntegrationScript = () => {
    if (!apiKey) {
      return `<!-- CMP Integration Script -->
<!-- Generate an API key first to get the integration code -->`;
    }

    const apiUrl = getAPIUrl();
    const scriptUrl = `https://d2xnsfhy4loimh.cloudfront.net/consent-banner.js`;
    const bannerId = initialData?.id || null;

    return `<!-- CMP Integration Script -->
<script>
  window.CMP_API_URL = "${apiUrl}";
  window.CMP_API_KEY = "${apiKey.key}";
  window.CMP_BANNER_ID = ${bannerId};
</script>
<script src="${scriptUrl}"></script>
<!-- Auto-initializes - no CMP.init() needed! -->`;
  };

  const themes = [
    { id: "blue", name: "Blue", color: "#3F72AF" },
    { id: "green", name: "Green", color: "#10B981" },
    { id: "red", name: "Red", color: "#EF4444" },
    { id: "dark", name: "Dark", color: "#112D4E" },
    { id: "custom", name: "Custom", color: formData.customColor },
  ];

  const languages = [
    { code: "en", name: "English (US)" },
    { code: "en-GB", name: "English (UK)" },
    { code: "es", name: "Spanish" },
    { code: "fr", name: "French" },
    { code: "de", name: "German" },
    { code: "it", name: "Italian" },
    { code: "pt", name: "Portuguese" },
    { code: "nl", name: "Dutch" },
    { code: "pl", name: "Polish" },
    { code: "ja", name: "Japanese" },
    { code: "zh", name: "Chinese" },
    { code: "ar", name: "Arabic" },
  ];

  const handleSave = () => {
    // Validate required fields
    if (!formData.bannerName.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter a banner name.");
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.bannerTitle.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter a banner title.");
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.bannerMessage.trim()) {
      alert("Please enter a banner message.");
      return;
    }

    // Call the save callback
    if (onSave) {
      onSave(formData);
    }
    onClose();
  };

  const sections = [
    { id: "basic", label: "Basic Information", icon: FaShieldAlt },
    { id: "display", label: "Display Settings", icon: FaPalette },
    { id: "content", label: "Content", icon: FaAlignLeft },
    { id: "categories", label: "Privacy Categories", icon: FaCheckCircle },
    { id: "language", label: "Languages", icon: FaGlobe },
    { id: "advanced", label: "Advanced", icon: FaCog },
    // Only show Script Integration when editing an existing banner
    ...(initialData
      ? [{ id: "integration", label: "Script Integration", icon: FaCode }]
      : []),
  ];

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 animate-fade-in"
      style={{ animation: "fadeIn 0.3s ease-out" }}
      aria-modal="true"
      role="dialog"
    >
      <style>{`
        @keyframes fadeIn {
          from {
            opacity: 0;
          }
          to {
            opacity: 1;
          }
        }
        
        @keyframes fadeInDown {
          from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(-20px);
          }
          to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
          }
        }
        
        @keyframes fadeInUp {
          from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(20px);
          }
          to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
          }
        }
        
        @keyframes scaleIn {
          from {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.95) translateY(10px);
          }
          to {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
          }
        }
        
        .animate-fade-in {
          animation-fill-mode: both;
        }
      `}</style>
      <div
        className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-5xl h-[90vh] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden transform transition-all duration-300 animate-fade-in"
        style={{ animation: "scaleIn 0.3s ease-out" }}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div
          className="flex items-center justify-between px-10 py-6 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F9F7F7] to-[#DBE2EF]/50 border-b border-[#DBE2EF] flex-shrink-0 animate-fade-in"
          style={{ animation: "fadeInDown 0.4s ease-out" }}
        >
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-[#112D4E]">
            {initialData ? "Edit Consent Banner" : "Create Consent Banner"}
          </h2>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-[#3F72AF] hover:text-[#112D4E] hover:bg-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl p-2 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-110 active:scale-95"
            aria-label="Close Modal"
          >
            <FaTimes size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Sidebar Navigation */}
        <div className="flex flex-1 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="w-64 bg-[#F9F7F7] border-r border-[#DBE2EF] flex-shrink-0 overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="p-4 space-y-2">
              {sections.map((section, idx) => {
                const Icon = section.icon;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={section.id}
                    onClick={() => setActiveSection(section.id)}
                    className={`w-full flex items-center space-x-3 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 text-left animate-fade-in font-semibold transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden group shadow-md ${
                      activeSection === section.id
                        ? "bg-[#3F72AF] text-white hover:bg-[#112D4E] hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/30"
                        : "bg-white text-[#112D4E] hover:bg-[#3F72AF] hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                    style={{
                      animation: `fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out ${idx * 0.1}s both`,
                    }}
                  >
                    <Icon size={16} className="relative z-10" />
                    <span className="text-sm relative z-10">
                      {section.label}
                    </span>
                    <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Main Content */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto bg-[#F9F7F7]">
            <div className="px-10 py-10 space-y-8">
              {/* Basic Information Section */}
              {activeSection === "basic" && (
                <div
                  className="animate-fade-in"
                  style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
                >
                  <h3 className="mb-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#112D4E]">
                    Basic Information
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                        Banner Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={formData.bannerName}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange("bannerName", e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="e.g., Main Website Consent Banner"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                        Description
                      </label>
                      <textarea
                        value={formData.description}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange("description", e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Brief description of this banner's purpose..."
                        rows="3"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300 resize-none"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Display Settings Section */}
              {activeSection === "display" && (
                <div
                  className="animate-fade-in"
                  style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
                >
                  <h3 className="mb-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#112D4E]">
                    Display Settings
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-4">
                        Display Style <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        {["banner", "modal"].map((style) => (
                          <button
                            key={style}
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleInputChange("displayStyle", style)
                            }
                            className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 ${
                              formData.displayStyle === style
                                ? "border-[#3F72AF] bg-[#3F72AF]/10 text-[#3F72AF] font-semibold"
                                : "border-[#DBE2EF] bg-white text-[#112D4E] hover:border-[#3F72AF]/50"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {style.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + style.slice(1)}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-4">
                        Position <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <div
                        className={`grid gap-4 ${
                          formData.displayStyle === "modal"
                            ? "grid-cols-3"
                            : "grid-cols-2"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {(() => {
                          // Get position options based on display style
                          let positions = [];
                          if (formData.displayStyle === "banner") {
                            positions = ["top", "bottom"];
                          } else if (formData.displayStyle === "modal") {
                            positions = ["top", "center", "bottom"];
                          }

                          return positions.map((pos) => (
                            <button
                              key={pos}
                              onClick={() => handleInputChange("position", pos)}
                              className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 ${
                                formData.position === pos
                                  ? "border-[#3F72AF] bg-[#3F72AF]/10 text-[#3F72AF] font-semibold"
                                  : "border-[#DBE2EF] bg-white text-[#112D4E] hover:border-[#3F72AF]/50"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {pos.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + pos.slice(1)}
                            </button>
                          ));
                        })()}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-4">
                        Theme <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-4">
                        {themes.map((theme) => (
                          <button
                            key={theme.id}
                            onClick={() => handleInputChange("theme", theme.id)}
                            className={`flex flex-col items-center space-y-2 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 ${
                              formData.theme === theme.id
                                ? "border-[#3F72AF] bg-[#3F72AF]/10"
                                : "border-[#DBE2EF] bg-white hover:border-[#3F72AF]/50"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <div
                              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: theme.color }}
                            />
                            <span
                              className={`text-xs font-medium ${
                                formData.theme === theme.id
                                  ? "text-[#3F72AF]"
                                  : "text-[#112D4E]"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {theme.name}
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      {formData.theme === "custom" && (
                        <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-[#DBE2EF]">
                          <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                            Custom Color
                          </label>
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
                            <input
                              type="color"
                              value={formData.customColor}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleInputChange("customColor", e.target.value)
                              }
                              className="w-16 h-12 rounded-lg border-2 border-[#DBE2EF] cursor-pointer transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#3F72AF]"
                            />
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              value={formData.customColor}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                handleInputChange("customColor", e.target.value)
                              }
                              placeholder="#9333EA"
                              className="flex-1 px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300 font-mono text-sm"
                              pattern="^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3})$"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-2">
                            Select a custom color for your banner theme
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Content Section */}
              {activeSection === "content" && (
                <div
                  className="animate-fade-in"
                  style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
                >
                  <h3 className="mb-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#112D4E]">
                    Banner Content
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                        Banner Title <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={formData.bannerTitle}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange("bannerTitle", e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Privacy Settings"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                        Banner Message <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <textarea
                        value={formData.bannerMessage}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange("bannerMessage", e.target.value)
                        }
                        placeholder="Enter the main message for your consent banner..."
                        rows="4"
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300 resize-none"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                          Accept Button Text
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={formData.acceptButtonText}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            handleInputChange(
                              "acceptButtonText",
                              e.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                          Reject Button Text
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={formData.rejectButtonText}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            handleInputChange(
                              "rejectButtonText",
                              e.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                          Settings Button Text
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={formData.settingsButtonText}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            handleInputChange(
                              "settingsButtonText",
                              e.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E]">
                          Show Privacy Policy Link
                        </label>
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            handleInputChange(
                              "showPrivacyPolicyLink",
                              !formData.showPrivacyPolicyLink
                            )
                          }
                          className={`relative w-12 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors duration-300 ${
                            formData.showPrivacyPolicyLink
                              ? "bg-[#3F72AF]"
                              : "bg-gray-300"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span
                            className={`absolute top-1 left-1 w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full transition-transform duration-300 ${
                              formData.showPrivacyPolicyLink
                                ? "translate-x-6"
                                : "translate-x-0"
                            }`}
                          />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                      {formData.showPrivacyPolicyLink && (
                        <input
                          type="url"
                          value={formData.privacyPolicyUrl}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            handleInputChange(
                              "privacyPolicyUrl",
                              e.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          placeholder="https://example.com/privacy-policy"
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300 mt-2"
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Privacy Categories Section */}
              {activeSection === "categories" && (
                <div
                  className="animate-fade-in"
                  style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
                >
                  <h3 className="mb-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#112D4E]">
                    Privacy Categories
                  </h3>
                  <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="divide-y divide-[#DBE2EF]">
                      {Object.entries(formData.categories).map(
                        ([key, category], idx) => (
                          <div
                            key={key}
                            className="p-6 hover:bg-[#DBE2EF]/20 transition-colors duration-200 animate-fade-in"
                            style={{
                              animation: `fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out ${
                                idx * 0.1
                              }s both`,
                            }}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                              <div className="flex-1">
                                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 mb-3">
                                  <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E]">
                                    {category.label}
                                  </h4>
                                  {category.required && (
                                    <span className="px-2 py-1 text-xs bg-[#DBE2EF] text-[#3F72AF] rounded-md font-medium">
                                      Required
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                                <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mb-4">
                                  {key === "necessary" &&
                                    "Essential cookies required for the website to function properly."}
                                  {key === "analytics" &&
                                    "Help us understand how visitors interact with our website."}
                                  {key === "marketing" &&
                                    "Used to deliver personalized advertisements."}
                                  {key === "personalization" &&
                                    "Enable enhanced functionality and personalization."}
                                  {key === "functional" &&
                                    "Enable enhanced functionality and features."}
                                  {key === "social" &&
                                    "Enable social media widgets and embeds."}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                              <div className="ml-4">
                                <button
                                  onClick={() =>
                                    !category.required &&
                                    handleCategoryChange(
                                      key,
                                      "enabled",
                                      !category.enabled
                                    )
                                  }
                                  disabled={category.required}
                                  className={`relative w-12 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors duration-300 ${
                                    category.enabled
                                      ? "bg-[#3F72AF]"
                                      : "bg-gray-300"
                                  } ${
                                    category.required
                                      ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed"
                                      : "cursor-pointer"
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  <span
                                    className={`absolute top-1 left-1 w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full transition-transform duration-300 ${
                                      category.enabled
                                        ? "translate-x-6"
                                        : "translate-x-0"
                                    }`}
                                  />
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Language Settings Section */}
              {activeSection === "language" && (
                <div
                  className="animate-fade-in"
                  style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
                >
                  <h3 className="mb-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#112D4E]">
                    Language Settings
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-4">
                        Primary Language <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                      </label>
                      <select
                        value={formData.primaryLanguage}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          handleInputChange("primaryLanguage", e.target.value)
                        }
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                      >
                        {languages.map((lang) => (
                          <option key={lang.code} value={lang.code}>
                            {lang.name}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-4">
                        Additional Languages
                      </label>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                        {languages
                          .filter(
                            (lang) => lang.code !== formData.primaryLanguage
                          )
                          .map((lang, idx) => (
                            <button
                              key={lang.code}
                              onClick={() => handleLanguageToggle(lang.code)}
                              className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 text-left animate-fade-in ${
                                formData.additionalLanguages.includes(lang.code)
                                  ? "border-[#3F72AF] bg-[#3F72AF]/10 text-[#3F72AF] font-semibold"
                                  : "border-[#DBE2EF] bg-white text-[#112D4E] hover:border-[#3F72AF]/50"
                              }`}
                              style={{
                                animation: `fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out ${
                                  idx * 0.05
                                }s both`,
                              }}
                            >
                              {lang.name}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Advanced Settings Section */}
              {activeSection === "advanced" && (
                <div
                  className="animate-fade-in"
                  style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
                >
                  <h3 className="mb-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#112D4E]">
                    Advanced Settings
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                        <div>
                          <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E]">
                            Show on First Visit Only
                          </label>
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-1">
                            Only display the banner on the user's first visit
                          </p>
                        </div>
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            handleInputChange(
                              "showOnFirstVisitOnly",
                              !formData.showOnFirstVisitOnly
                            )
                          }
                          className={`relative w-12 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors duration-300 ${
                            formData.showOnFirstVisitOnly
                              ? "bg-[#3F72AF]"
                              : "bg-gray-300"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span
                            className={`absolute top-1 left-1 w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full transition-transform duration-300 ${
                              formData.showOnFirstVisitOnly
                                ? "translate-x-6"
                                : "translate-x-0"
                            }`}
                          />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                          Cookie Expiration (days)
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={formData.cookieExpiration}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            handleInputChange(
                              "cookieExpiration",
                              e.target.value
                            )
                          }
                          min="1"
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                          Auto-hide Delay (seconds)
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={formData.autoHideDelay}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            handleInputChange("autoHideDelay", e.target.value)
                          }
                          min="0"
                          placeholder="0 = don't auto-hide"
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div>
                            <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E]">
                              Show Reject Button
                            </label>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-1">
                              Allow users to reject all cookies
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <button
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleInputChange(
                                "showRejectButton",
                                !formData.showRejectButton
                              )
                            }
                            className={`relative w-12 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors duration-300 ${
                              formData.showRejectButton
                                ? "bg-[#3F72AF]"
                                : "bg-gray-300"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span
                              className={`absolute top-1 left-1 w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full transition-transform duration-300 ${
                                formData.showRejectButton
                                  ? "translate-x-6"
                                  : "translate-x-0"
                              }`}
                            />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <div>
                            <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E]">
                              Show Settings Button
                            </label>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-1">
                              Allow users to customize preferences
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <button
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleInputChange(
                                "showSettingsButton",
                                !formData.showSettingsButton
                              )
                            }
                            className={`relative w-12 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors duration-300 ${
                              formData.showSettingsButton
                                ? "bg-[#3F72AF]"
                                : "bg-gray-300"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span
                              className={`absolute top-1 left-1 w-4 h-4 bg-white rounded-full transition-transform duration-300 ${
                                formData.showSettingsButton
                                  ? "translate-x-6"
                                  : "translate-x-0"
                              }`}
                            />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Script Integration Section */}
              {activeSection === "integration" && (
                <div
                  className="animate-fade-in"
                  style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
                >
                  <h3 className="mb-6 text-xl font-bold text-[#112D4E]">
                    Script Integration
                  </h3>
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    {/* API Key Management */}
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <h4 className="text-lg font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-4">
                        CMP API Key
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">
                        Generate an API key for your organization to integrate
                        the consent banner on your website. Only one active API
                        key is allowed per organization.
                      </p>

                      <div className="space-y-4">
                        <div>
                          <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                            Organization <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={user?.organization?.name || ""}
                            disabled
                            className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 cursor-not-allowed"
                          />
                        </div>

                        <div>
                          <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                            Key Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={apiKeyName}
                            onChange={(e) => setApiKeyName(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g., Production Website Key"
                            disabled={!!apiKey}
                            className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent transition-all duration-300 disabled:bg-gray-100 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                          />
                          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                            A descriptive name to identify this API key (same as
                            in Django admin)
                          </p>
                        </div>

                        {apiKey && (
                          <div className="bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-xl p-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-green-800">
                                Active API Key
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-xs text-green-600">
                                Created:{" "}
                                {new Date(
                                  apiKey.created_at
                                ).toLocaleDateString()}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                              <div className="relative flex-1">
                                <code className="block w-full px-3 py-2 pr-10 bg-white border border-green-200 rounded text-sm font-mono text-gray-800 break-all">
                                  {showApiKey
                                    ? apiKey.key
                                    : "•".repeat(apiKey.key.length)}
                                </code>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => setShowApiKey(!showApiKey)}
                                  onMouseDown={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-500 hover:text-[#3F72AF] transition-colors duration-200 p-1"
                                  aria-label={
                                    showApiKey ? "Hide API key" : "Show API key"
                                  }
                                >
                                  {showApiKey ? (
                                    <FaEyeSlash size={16} />
                                  ) : (
                                    <FaEye size={16} />
                                  )}
                                </button>
                              </div>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => copyToClipboard(apiKey.key)}
                                className="px-4 py-2 bg-[#3F72AF] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#112D4E] transition-all duration-300 flex items-center space-x-2"
                              >
                                {copied ? (
                                  <>
                                    <FaCheck size={14} />
                                    <span>Copied!</span>
                                  </>
                                ) : (
                                  <>
                                    <FaCopy size={14} />
                                    <span>Copy</span>
                                  </>
                                )}
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )}

                        <button
                          onClick={generateAPIKey}
                          disabled={
                            loadingApiKey || !apiKeyName.trim() || !!apiKey
                          }
                          className="w-full px-6 py-3 bg-[#3F72AF] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#112D4E] transition-all duration-300 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                        >
                          {loadingApiKey ? "Generating..." : "Generate API Key"}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Integration Script */}
                    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 border border-[#DBE2EF] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/20 transition-all duration-300">
                      <h4 className="text-lg font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-4">
                        Integration Script
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">
                        Copy and paste this script into your website's HTML to
                        integrate the consent banner.
                      </p>

                      <div className="relative">
                        <textarea
                          value={getIntegrationScript()}
                          readOnly
                          rows={12}
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent font-mono text-sm bg-gray-50 resize-none"
                        />
                        <button
                          onClick={() =>
                            copyToClipboard(getIntegrationScript())
                          }
                          className="absolute top-4 right-4 px-4 py-2 bg-[#3F72AF] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#112D4E] transition-all duration-300 flex items-center space-x-2"
                        >
                          {copied ? (
                            <>
                              <FaCheck size={14} />
                              <span>Copied!</span>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <FaCopy size={14} />
                              <span>Copy Script</span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {!apiKey && (
                        <div className="mt-4 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-xl p-4">
                          <p className="text-sm text-yellow-800">
                            ⚠️ Please generate an API key first to get the
                            integration script.
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div
          className="bg-[#F9F7F7] flex items-center justify-end px-10 py-4 border-t border-[#DBE2EF] space-x-3 flex-shrink-0 animate-fade-in"
          style={{ animation: "fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out" }}
        >
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-6 py-3 bg-white text-red-500 rounded-xl border border-red-500 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white shadow-md hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-red-500/30 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer font-semibold relative overflow-hidden group"
          >
            <span className="relative z-10">Cancel</span>
            <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={handleSave}
            className="px-6 py-3 bg-[#3F72AF] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#112D4E] hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-[#3F72AF]/30 font-semibold transition-all duration-300 transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden group shadow-md"
          >
            <span className="relative z-10">
              {initialData ? "Update Banner" : "Create Banner"}
            </span>
            <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/0 via-white/20 to-white/0 translate-x-[-100%] group-hover:translate-x-[100%] transition-transform duration-700"></span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
