```python
def _test_google_drive(connection: Dict[str, Any], auth: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Test Google Drive connection."""
    
    # Check if using public URL mode
    public_url = connection.get("public_url")
    if public_url:
        return _test_google_drive_public(public_url, auth.get("api_key"))
    
    # OAuth mode
    try:
        from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
        from googleapiclient.discovery import build
        from google.auth.transport.requests import Request
        from google.auth.exceptions import RefreshError
        
        client_id = auth.get("client_id")
        client_secret = auth.get("client_secret")
        refresh_token = auth.get("refresh_token")
        
        if not all([client_id, client_secret, refresh_token]):
            return False, "Missing required Google Drive OAuth credentials"
        
        # Strip whitespace and newlines from refresh token
        refresh_token = refresh_token.strip().replace('\n', '').replace('\r', '')
        
        logger.info(f"Testing Google Drive connection with client_id: {client_id[:20]}...")
        
        # Create credentials from refresh token
        # Note: Scopes must match the scopes used when generating the refresh token
        creds = Credentials(
            token=None,
            refresh_token=refresh_token,
            token_uri="https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
            client_id=client_id,
            client_secret=client_secret,
            scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive']
        )
        
        # Refresh the token to ensure it's valid
        try:
            if not creds.valid:
                logger.info("Refreshing access token...")
                creds.refresh(Request())
                logger.info("Access token refreshed successfully")
        except RefreshError as refresh_err:
            error_msg = str(refresh_err)
            logger.error(f"Token refresh failed: {error_msg}")
            # Provide more specific error messages
            if "invalid_grant" in error_msg.lower():
                return False, "Invalid refresh token. The token may have been revoked or expired. Please generate a new refresh token."
            elif "invalid_client" in error_msg.lower():
                return False, f"Invalid OAuth client credentials. Please verify your Client ID and Client Secret are correct. Error: {error_msg}"
            else:
                return False, f"Token refresh failed: {error_msg}"
        
        # Test by building Drive service
        logger.info("Building Drive service...")
        service = build('drive', 'v3', credentials=creds)
        
        # Test connection by getting about info
        logger.info("Testing connection by fetching user info...")
        about = service.about().get(fields='user').execute()
        
        user_name = about.get('user', {}).get('displayName', 'Unknown')
        logger.info(f"Successfully connected to Google Drive as: {user_name}")
        
        return True, f"Successfully connected to Google Drive (User: {user_name})"
    except ImportError as import_err:
        error_msg = "google-api-python-client and google-auth packages not installed. Install with: pip install google-api-python-client google-auth-httplib2 google-auth-oauthlib"
        logger.error(f"Import error: {error_msg}")
        return False, error_msg
    except Exception as e:
        error_msg = str(e)
        error_type = type(e).__name__
        logger.error(f"Google Drive connection failed: {error_type}: {error_msg}", exc_info=True)
        return False, f"Google Drive connection failed: {error_msg}"


def _test_google_drive_public(public_url: str, api_key: str = None) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Test public Google Drive file/folder access."""
    import re
    
    if not public_url:
        return False, "Public URL is required"
    
    # Extract file or folder ID from URL
    file_match = re.search(r'/file/d/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)', public_url)
    folder_match = re.search(r'/folders/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)', public_url)
    
    if file_match:
        file_id = file_match.group(1)
        # Test file accessibility
        download_url = f"https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id={file_id}"
        try:
            response = requests.head(download_url, allow_redirects=True, timeout=10)
            if response.status_code == 200:
                return True, f"Successfully accessed public file (ID: {file_id[:8]}...)"
            elif response.status_code == 404:
                return False, "File not found. Check if the URL is correct."
            else:
                return False, f"File not accessible (Status: {response.status_code}). Make sure it's shared as 'Anyone with the link'."
        except Exception as e:
            return False, f"Error accessing file: {str(e)}"
    
    elif folder_match:
        folder_id = folder_match.group(1)
        if api_key:
            # Use API key to list folder contents
            try:
                from googleapiclient.discovery import build
                service = build('drive', 'v3', developerKey=api_key)
                query = f"'{folder_id}' in parents and trashed=false"
                results = service.files().list(q=query, pageSize=1, fields="files(id, name)").execute()
                files = results.get('files', [])
                return True, f"Successfully accessed public folder (ID: {folder_id[:8]}..., {len(files)}+ files found)"
            except Exception as e:
                error_msg = str(e)
                if "notFound" in error_msg:
                    return False, "Folder not found or not public. Make sure it's shared as 'Anyone with the link'."
                elif "API key" in error_msg or "invalid" in error_msg.lower():
                    return False, "Invalid API key. Get a valid key from Google Cloud Console."
                return False, f"Error accessing folder: {error_msg}"
        else:
            # Without API key, we can only validate the folder ID format
            return True, f"Folder ID extracted: {folder_id[:8]}... (Add API key for full folder listing)"
    
    return False, "Invalid Google Drive URL. Use a file or folder share link (e.g., drive.google.com/file/d/... or drive.google.com/drive/folders/...)"


def _test_sftp(connection: Dict[str, Any], auth: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Test SFTP connection."""
    try:
        import paramiko
        
        host = connection.get("host")
        port = connection.get("port", 22)
        username = auth.get("username")
        password = auth.get("password")
        private_key = auth.get("private_key")
        remote_path = connection.get("remote_path", "/")
        
        if not all([host, username]):
            return False, "Missing required SFTP credentials (host, username)"
        
        ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
        ssh.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
        
        if private_key:
            # Use private key authentication
            try:
                if isinstance(private_key, str) and private_key.startswith('/'):
                    # File path
                    key = paramiko.RSAKey.from_private_key_file(private_key)
                else:
                    # Key string
                    from io import StringIO
                    key_file = StringIO(private_key)
                    key = paramiko.RSAKey.from_private_key(key_file)
                ssh.connect(host, port=port, username=username, pkey=key, timeout=10)
            except Exception as e:
                return False, f"SFTP private key authentication failed: {str(e)}"
        else:
            # Use password authentication
            if not password:
                return False, "SFTP password or private key required"
            ssh.connect(host, port=port, username=username, password=password, timeout=10)
        
        # Test by listing directory
        sftp = ssh.open_sftp()
        sftp.listdir(remote_path)
        sftp.close()
        ssh.close()
        
        return True, f"Successfully connected to SFTP server: {host}:{port}"
    except ImportError:
        return False, "paramiko package not installed. Install with: pip install paramiko"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"SFTP connection failed: {str(e)}"


def test_api_connection(connection_details: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Test API connection.
    
    Args:
        connection_details: Dictionary containing connection parameters
        
    Returns:
        Tuple of (success: bool, message: str)
    """
    try:
        connection = connection_details.get("connection", {})
        auth = connection_details.get("authentication", {})
        
        base_url = connection.get("base_url")
        if not base_url:
            return False, "Missing required API base URL"
        
        # Prepare headers
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        auth_type = auth.get("type", "api_key")
        
        # Handle different authentication types
        if auth_type == "none":
            # No authentication required - proceed without auth headers
            pass
        elif auth_type == "api_key":
            api_key = auth.get("api_key")
            if api_key:
                headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {api_key}"
        elif auth_type == "bearer_token":
            bearer_token = auth.get("api_key")  # Reuse api_key field for bearer token
            if bearer_token:
                headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {bearer_token}"
        elif auth_type == "basic_auth":
            username = auth.get("username")
            password = auth.get("password")
            if username and password:
                import base64
                credentials = base64.b64encode(f"{username}:{password}".encode()).decode()
                headers["Authorization"] = f"Basic {credentials}"
        elif auth_type == "oauth":
            # OAuth 2.0 is not yet fully implemented
            # For now, try to use api_key if provided as a fallback
            oauth_token = auth.get("api_key") or auth.get("access_token")
            if oauth_token:
                headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {oauth_token}"
            else:
                return False, "OAuth 2.0 authentication is not yet fully implemented. Please use API Key or Bearer Token instead."
        
        # Test connection with a simple GET request
        # Use the exact URL provided (don't modify it)
        response = requests.get(
            base_url,
            headers=headers,
            timeout=10,
            allow_redirects=True
        )
        
        # Any 2xx or 3xx response indicates the API is reachable
        if 200 <= response.status_code < 400:
            return True, f"Successfully connected to API. Status: {response.status_code}"
        else:
            return False, f"API returned error status: {response.status_code}"
            
    except requests.exceptions.ConnectionError:
        return False, "Cannot connect to API endpoint. Check URL and network connectivity."
    except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
        return False, "API connection timeout. Server may be slow or unreachable."
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"API connection test failed: {str(e)}"


def test_logs_connection(connection_details: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """
    Test logs connection (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Logging, Splunk).
    
    Args:
        connection_details: Dictionary containing connection parameters
        
    Returns:
        Tuple of (success: bool, message: str)
    """
    try:
        provider = connection_details.get("provider", "")
        connection = connection_details.get("connection", {})
        auth = connection_details.get("authentication", {})
        
        if provider == "aws_cloudwatch":
            return _test_cloudwatch(connection, auth)
        elif provider == "azure_monitor":
            return _test_azure_monitor(connection, auth)
        elif provider == "gcp_logging":
            return _test_gcp_logging(connection, auth)
        elif provider == "splunk":
            return _test_splunk(connection, auth)
        else:
            return False, f"Unsupported log provider: {provider}"
            
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Logs connection test error: {str(e)}")
        return False, f"Connection test failed: {str(e)}"


def _test_cloudwatch(connection: Dict[str, Any], auth: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Test AWS CloudWatch Logs connection."""
    try:
        log_group = connection.get("log_group")
        region = connection.get("region", "us-east-1")
        access_key = auth.get("aws_access_key_id")
        secret_key = auth.get("aws_secret_access_key")
        
        if not all([log_group, access_key, secret_key]):
            return False, "Missing required CloudWatch credentials"
        
        logs_client = boto3.client(
            'logs',
            aws_access_key_id=access_key,
            aws_secret_access_key=secret_key,
            region_name=region
        )
        
        # Test by describing the log group
        logs_client.describe_log_groups(logGroupNamePrefix=log_group, limit=1)
        
        return True, f"Successfully connected to CloudWatch log group: {log_group}"
    except ClientError as e:
        return False, f"CloudWatch connection failed: {str(e)}"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"CloudWatch test error: {str(e)}"


def _test_azure_monitor(connection: Dict[str, Any], auth: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Test Azure Monitor Logs connection."""
    try:
        from azure.identity import ClientSecretCredential
        from azure.monitor.query import LogsQueryClient
        
        workspace_id = connection.get("workspace_id")
        tenant_id = auth.get("azure_tenant_id")
        client_id = auth.get("azure_client_id")
        client_secret = auth.get("azure_client_secret")
        
        if not all([workspace_id, tenant_id, client_id, client_secret]):
            return False, "Missing required Azure Monitor credentials"
        
        # Create credential and client
        credential = ClientSecretCredential(tenant_id, client_id, client_secret)
        client = LogsQueryClient(credential)
        
        # Test by running a simple query
        query = "AzureActivity | take 1"
        response = client.query_workspace(workspace_id, query, timespan=timedelta(hours=1))
        
        return True, f"Successfully connected to Azure Monitor (Workspace: {workspace_id})"
    except ImportError:
        return False, "azure-monitor-query package not installed. Install with: pip install azure-monitor-query azure-identity"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"Azure Monitor connection failed: {str(e)}"


def _test_gcp_logging(connection: Dict[str, Any], auth: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Test GCP Cloud Logging connection."""
    try:
        from google.cloud import logging
        import json
        from google.oauth2 import service_account
        
        project_id = connection.get("project_id")
        service_account_json = auth.get("gcp_service_account_json")
        
        if not all([project_id, service_account_json]):
            return False, "Missing required GCP Logging credentials"
        
        if isinstance(service_account_json, str):
            credentials_info = json.loads(service_account_json)
        else:
            credentials_info = service_account_json
        
        credentials = service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_info(credentials_info)
        
        client = logging.Client(project=project_id, credentials=credentials)
        # Test by listing log entries (limit 1)
        entries = list(client.list_entries(max_results=1))
        
        return True, f"Successfully connected to GCP Cloud Logging (Project: {project_id})"
    except ImportError:
        return False, "google-cloud-logging package not installed. Install with: pip install google-cloud-logging"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"GCP Logging connection failed: {str(e)}"


def _test_splunk(connection: Dict[str, Any], auth: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Test Splunk connection."""
    try:
        host = connection.get("host")
        port = connection.get("port", 8089)
        username = auth.get("username")
        password = auth.get("password")
        index = connection.get("index", "main")
        
        if not all([host, username, password]):
            return False, "Missing required Splunk credentials"
        
        # Test by making a simple API call to Splunk
        from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth
        
        url = f"https://{host}:{port}/services/data/indexes/{index}"
        response = requests.get(
            url,
            auth=HTTPBasicAuth(username, password),
            verify=False,  # Splunk often uses self-signed certs
            timeout=10
        )
        
        if response.status_code == 200:
            return True, f"Successfully connected to Splunk (Index: {index})"
        else:
            return False, f"Splunk connection failed with status: {response.status_code}"
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"Splunk connection failed: {str(e)}"
```

```javascriptreact
        details.authentication = {

      } else if (formState.provider === "gcp_storage") {

        details.authentication = {
          gcp_service_account_json: formState.gcpServiceAccountJson,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "google_drive") {
        if (formState.googleDriveUsePublicUrl) {
          // Public URL mode (simpler)

        };
        details.authentication = {

          private_key: formState.sshPrivateKey || undefined,

      }
    } else if (formState.sourceType === "api") {
      details.connection = {
        base_url: formState.baseUrl,

      details.authentication = {
        type: formState.authType,
        api_key: formState.apiKey || undefined,
        username: formState.username || undefined,

    } else if (formState.sourceType === "logs") {
      details.connection = {
        provider: formState.provider,
      };

      if (formState.provider === "aws_cloudwatch") {
        details.connection.log_group = formState.databaseName; // Log group name
        details.connection.region = formState.region || undefined;
        details.authentication = {
          aws_access_key_id: formState.awsAccessKeyId,
          aws_secret_access_key: formState.awsSecretAccessKey,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "azure_monitor") {
        details.connection.workspace_name = formState.databaseName; // Workspace name
        details.connection.resource_group = formState.region; // Resource group
        details.authentication = {
          azure_tenant_id: formState.azureTenantId,
          azure_client_id: formState.azureClientId,
          azure_client_secret: formState.azureClientSecret,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "gcp_logging") {
        details.connection.log_name = formState.databaseName; // Log name/filter
        details.connection.project_id = formState.gcpProjectId;
        details.authentication = {
          gcp_service_account_json: formState.gcpServiceAccountJson,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "splunk") {
        details.connection = {
          host: formState.host,
          port: parseInt(formState.port) || 8089,
          index: formState.databaseName, // Index name
        };
        details.authentication = {
          username: formState.username,
          password: formState.password,
        };
      }
    }

    return details;
  };

  const handleAddSource = async () => {
    if (!formState.sourceType || !formState.name) {
      alert("Please provide a name and source type.");
      return;
    }

    // Validate required fields based on source type
    if (
      (formState.sourceType === "database" ||
        formState.sourceType === "cloud") &&
      !formState.host
    ) {
      alert("Please provide a host/server address.");
      return;
    }

    if (formState.sourceType === "files") {
      if (!formState.provider) {
        alert("Please select a storage provider.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "aws_s3" &&
        (!formState.bucketName || !formState.region)
      ) {
        alert("Please provide bucket name and region for AWS S3.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "azure_blob" &&
        (!formState.storageAccountName || !formState.containerName)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide storage account name and container name for Azure Blob Storage."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "gcp_storage" &&
        (!formState.bucketName || !formState.gcpProjectId)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide bucket name and GCP project ID for Google Cloud Storage."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (formState.provider === "google_drive") {
        if (formState.googleDriveUsePublicUrl) {
          // Public URL mode validation
          if (!formState.googleDrivePublicUrl) {
            alert("Please provide the Google Drive public share URL.");
            return;
          }
          // Validate URL format
          if (!formState.googleDrivePublicUrl.includes("drive.google.com")) {
            alert("Please provide a valid Google Drive URL (e.g., https://drive.google.com/file/d/... or https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/...)");
            return;
          }
        } else {
          // OAuth mode validation
          if (
            !formState.googleDriveClientId ||
            !formState.googleDriveClientSecret ||
            !formState.googleDriveRefreshToken
          ) {
            alert(
              "Please provide Client ID, Client Secret, and Refresh Token for Google Drive."
            );
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "sftp" &&
        (!formState.host || !formState.databaseName)
      ) {
        alert("Please provide host and remote path for SFTP.");
        return;
      }
    }

    if (formState.sourceType === "api") {
      if (!formState.baseUrl) {
        alert("Please provide a base URL for the API.");
        return;
      }
      // Only validate auth if authentication is required
      if (formState.authType !== "none") {
        if (formState.authType === "api_key" && !formState.apiKey) {
          alert("Please provide an API key.");
          return;
        }
        if (
          formState.authType === "bearer_token" && !formState.apiKey
        ) {
          alert("Please provide a bearer token.");
          return;
        }
        if (
          formState.authType === "basic_auth" &&
          (!formState.username || !formState.password)
        ) {
          alert("Please provide username and password for basic authentication.");
          return;
        }
        if (formState.authType === "oauth") {
          alert("OAuth 2.0 authentication is not yet fully implemented. Please use API Key or Bearer Token instead.");
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    if (formState.sourceType === "logs") {
      if (!formState.provider) {
        alert("Please select a log provider.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "aws_cloudwatch" &&
        (!formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.region ||
          !formState.awsAccessKeyId ||
          !formState.awsSecretAccessKey)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide log group name, region, and AWS credentials for CloudWatch."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "azure_monitor" &&
        (!formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.region ||
          !formState.azureTenantId ||
          !formState.azureClientId ||
          !formState.azureClientSecret)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide workspace name, resource group, and Azure credentials for Azure Monitor."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "gcp_logging" &&
        (!formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.gcpProjectId ||
          !formState.gcpServiceAccountJson)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide log name/filter, project ID, and GCP service account JSON for Cloud Logging."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "splunk" &&
        (!formState.host ||
          !formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.username ||
          !formState.password)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide host, index name, username, and password for Splunk."
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    try {
      const connectionDetails = buildConnectionDetails();
      
      if (editingSource) {
        // Update existing source
        if (onUpdateSource) {
          await onUpdateSource(editingSource.id, {
            sourceType: formState.sourceType,
            name: formState.name,
            connectionDetails: connectionDetails,
            notes: formState.notes,
          });
        }
        setEditingSource(null);
      } else {
        // Create new source
        if (onAddSource) {
          await onAddSource({
            sourceType: formState.sourceType,
            name: formState.name,
            status: "connected",
            connectionDetails: connectionDetails,
            notes: formState.notes,
          });
        }
      }
      
      // Reset form
      setFormState({
        sourceType: "",
        name: "",
        provider: "",
        databaseType: "",
        host: "",
        port: "",
        databaseName: "",
        region: "",
        authMethod: "username_password",
        username: "",
        password: "",
        awsAccessKeyId: "",
        awsSecretAccessKey: "",
        awsRoleArn: "",
        azureTenantId: "",
        azureClientId: "",
        azureClientSecret: "",
        gcpServiceAccountJson: "",
        gcpProjectId: "",
        sshHost: "",
        sshPort: "22",
        sshUsername: "",
        sshPassword: "",
        sshPrivateKey: "",
        sslEnabled: true,
        sslMode: "require",
        caCertificate: "",
        clientCertificate: "",
        clientKey: "",
        connectionTimeout: "30",
        rdsInstanceId: "",
        vpcSecurityGroups: "",
        subnetGroup: "",
        bucketName: "",
        storageAccountName: "",
        containerName: "",
        endpointUrl: "",
        googleDriveClientId: "",
        googleDriveClientSecret: "",
        googleDriveRefreshToken: "",
        googleDriveFolderId: "",
        googleDriveUsePublicUrl: true,
        googleDrivePublicUrl: "",
        googleDriveApiKey: "",
        baseUrl: "",
        apiKey: "",
        authType: "none",
        notes: "",
      });
      setShowAddModal(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to save data source", err);
      alert(`Unable to ${editingSource ? 'update' : 'add'} data source. Please try again.`);
    }
  };

  const handleTestConnection = async () => {
    if (!formState.sourceType) {
      alert("Please select a source type before testing connection.");
      return;
    }

    // Validate required fields based on source type
    if (formState.sourceType === "api" && !formState.baseUrl) {
      alert("Please provide a base URL for the API.");
      return;
    }
    if (
      (formState.sourceType === "database" || formState.sourceType === "cloud") &&
      !formState.host
    ) {
      alert("Please provide a host/server address.");
      return;
    }
    if (formState.sourceType === "files" && !formState.provider) {
      alert("Please select a storage provider.");
      return;
    }
    if (formState.sourceType === "logs" && !formState.provider) {
      alert("Please select a log provider.");
      return;
    }

    setTestingConnection(true);
    try {
      const connectionDetails = buildConnectionDetails();
      if (onTestConnection) {
        const result = await onTestConnection({
          sourceType: formState.sourceType,
          name: formState.name || `Test ${formState.sourceType}`,
          connectionDetails: connectionDetails,
        });
        
        // Handle different response formats (same as handleTestConnectionFromCard)
        if (result) {
          if (result.status === "success" || result.status === "ok") {
            const message = result.message || "Connection test successful!";
            alert(`✅ Connection test successful!\n${message}`);
          } else if (result.status === "error" || result.status === "failed") {
            const errorMsg = result.error || result.message || "Connection test failed";
            alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n${errorMsg}`);
          } else {
            // If no status field, check for success field
            if (result.success) {
              alert(`✅ Connection test successful!\n${result.message || ""}`);
            } else {
              alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n${result.error || result.message || "Unknown error"}`);
            }
          }
        } else {
          alert(`✅ Connection test completed`);
        }
      } else {
        // Fallback - just show alert
        alert(
          "Connection testing will be available after configuration is saved."
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Connection test error", err);
      console.error("Full error response:", err?.response);
      console.error("Error response data:", err?.response?.data);
      
      // Try to extract detailed error message from response
      let errorMsg = "Unknown error occurred";
      
      try {
        if (err?.response?.data) {
          const errorData = err.response.data;
          errorMsg = errorData.error || errorData.message || errorData.detail || JSON.stringify(errorData);
        } else if (err?.message) {
          errorMsg = err.message;
        }
      } catch (parseErr) {
        console.error("Error parsing error response:", parseErr);
        errorMsg = err?.message || "Failed to parse error response";
      }
      
      alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n\n${errorMsg}\n\nCheck browser console for detailed error information.`);
    } finally {
      setTestingConnection(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTestConnectionFromCard = async (source) => {
    if (!onTestConnection || !source.id) {
      alert("Unable to test connection. Source ID is missing.");
      return;
    }

    setTestingSourceId(source.id);
    try {
      const result = await onTestConnection(source.id);
      
      // Handle different response formats
      if (result) {
        if (result.status === "success" || result.status === "ok") {
          const message = result.message || `Connection to ${source.name} is working!`;
          alert(`✅ Connection test successful!\n${message}`);
        } else if (result.status === "error" || result.status === "failed") {
          const errorMsg = result.error || result.message || "Connection test failed";
          alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n${errorMsg}`);
        } else {
          // If no status field, assume success if we got a response
          alert(`✅ Connection test completed for ${source.name}`);
        }
      } else {
        alert(`✅ Connection test completed for ${source.name}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Connection test error", err);
      const errorMsg = 
        err?.response?.data?.error || 
        err?.response?.data?.message || 
        err?.message || 
        "Unknown error occurred";
      alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n${errorMsg}`);
    } finally {
      setTestingSourceId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (source) => {
    const details = source.connectionDetails || {};
    const connection = details.connection || {};
    const auth = details.authentication || {};
    const security = details.security || {};
    const sshTunnel = details.ssh_tunnel || {};
    const cloudSpecific = details.cloud_specific || {};

    // Populate form with existing data
    setFormState({
      sourceType: source.sourceType || "",
      name: source.name || "",
      provider: details.provider || "",
      databaseType: connection.database_type || "",
      host: connection.host || "",
      port: connection.port?.toString() || "",
      databaseName: connection.database || "",
      region: connection.region || "",
      authMethod: auth.method || "username_password",
      username: auth.username || "",
      password: auth.password || "",
      awsAccessKeyId: auth.aws_access_key_id || "",
      awsSecretAccessKey: auth.aws_secret_access_key || "",
      awsRoleArn: auth.aws_role_arn || "",
      azureTenantId: auth.azure_tenant_id || "",
      azureClientId: auth.azure_client_id || "",
      azureClientSecret: auth.azure_client_secret || "",
      gcpServiceAccountJson: auth.gcp_service_account_json || "",
      gcpProjectId: auth.gcp_project_id || connection.project_id || "",
      sshHost: sshTunnel.host || "",
      sshPort: sshTunnel.port?.toString() || "22",
      sshUsername: sshTunnel.username || "",
      sshPassword: sshTunnel.password || "",
      sshPrivateKey: sshTunnel.private_key || "",
      sslEnabled: security.ssl_enabled !== false,
      sslMode: security.ssl_mode || "require",
      caCertificate: security.ca_certificate || "",
      clientCertificate: security.client_certificate || "",
      clientKey: security.client_key || "",
      connectionTimeout: security.connection_timeout?.toString() || "30",
      rdsInstanceId: cloudSpecific.rds_instance_id || "",
      vpcSecurityGroups: cloudSpecific.vpc_security_groups?.join(", ") || "",
      subnetGroup: cloudSpecific.subnet_group || "",
      bucketName: connection.bucket_name || "",
      storageAccountName: connection.storage_account_name || "",
      containerName: connection.container_name || "",
      endpointUrl: connection.endpoint_url || "",
      // Google Drive specific
      googleDriveClientId: auth.client_id || "",
      googleDriveClientSecret: auth.client_secret || "",
      googleDriveRefreshToken: auth.refresh_token || "",
      googleDriveFolderId: connection.folder_id || "",
      googleDriveUsePublicUrl: !!connection.public_url,
      googleDrivePublicUrl: connection.public_url || "",
      googleDriveApiKey: auth.api_key || "",
      // API specific
      baseUrl: connection.base_url || "",
      apiKey: auth.api_key || "",
      authType: auth.type || "none",
      // Notes
      notes: source.notes || "",
    });

    setEditingSource(source);
    setShowAddModal(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (!onDeleteSource) return;
    if (
      !window.confirm("Delete this data source? This action cannot be undone.")
    ) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await onDeleteSource(id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to delete data source", err);
      alert("Unable to delete data source. Please try again.");
    }
  };

  // Render dynamic form fields based on source type and provider
  const renderDynamicFields = () => {
    if (!formState.sourceType) return null;

    // Database or Cloud source fields
    if (
      formState.sourceType === "database" ||
      formState.sourceType === "cloud"
    ) {
      return (
        <>
          {/* Provider Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
              Cloud Provider / Platform <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <select
              value={formState.provider}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setFormState((prev) => ({
                  ...prev,
                  provider: e.target.value,
                  authMethod: "username_password", // Reset auth method
                }))
              }
              className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent"
            >
              <option value="">Select provider...</option>
              {getProviderOptions().map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
                  {opt.label}
                </option>
              ))}

          {/* Database Type */}
          {formState.provider && formState.provider !== "other" && (

              <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                Database Type <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <select
                value={formState.databaseType}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setFormState((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    databaseType: e.target.value,
                  }))
                }
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent"
              >
                <option value="">Select database type...</option>

            </h3>

            <div className="space-y-4">

                </label>
                <input

                  placeholder="e.g., mydb.abc123.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com"
                  value={formState.host}

                    setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, host: e.target.value }))
                  }
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent font-mono text-sm"
                />

                        ? "5432"
                        : formState.databaseType === "mysql"

                    }
                    value={formState.port}
                    onChange={(e) =>

                        port: e.target.value,

                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-[#DBE2EF] rounded-xl focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3F72AF] focus:border-transparent"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">
                    Database Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input

              {[

                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-[#112D4E] mb-2">

                      !formState.sourceType ||
                      !formState.name
                    }
                    className="px-4 py-2 bg-white text-[#3F72AF] border border-[#3F72AF] rounded-xl hover:bg-[#3F72AF] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 font-semibold flex items-center space-x-2 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                  >
                    <FaPlug size={12} />
                    <span>
                      {testingConnection ? "Testing..." : "Test Connection"}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setShowAddModal(false);
                        setEditingSource(null);
                      }}
                      className="px-6 py-3 bg-white text-[#112D4E] rounded-xl border border-[#DBE2EF] hover:bg-[#F9F7F7] transition-colors duration-300 font-semibold"
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={handleAddSource}
                      disabled={!formState.sourceType || !formState.name}
                      className="px-6 py-3 bg-[#3F72AF] text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-[#112D4E] transition-colors duration-300 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    >
                      {editingSource ? "Update Source" : "Add Source"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { useAuth } from "../AuthContext";

const API_PREFIX = "/api/cmp";

const buildQueryString = (params = {}) => {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  Object.entries(params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") return;
    query.append(key, value);
  });
  const qs = query.toString();
  return qs ? `?${qs}` : "";
};

export function useCmpApi() {
  const { fetchWithAuth } = useAuth();

  const request = useCallback(
    async (endpoint, options = {}) => {
      // Only add Content-Type header for requests with a body (POST, PATCH, PUT)
      const hasBody = options.body !== undefined;
      const method = options.method?.toUpperCase() || "GET";
      const needsContentType = hasBody && ["POST", "PATCH", "PUT"].includes(method);

      const headers = needsContentType
        ? {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            ...options.headers,
          }
        : { ...options.headers };

      try {
        const response = await fetchWithAuth(`${API_PREFIX}${endpoint}`, {
          ...options,
          headers,
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          let errorDetails = null;
          try {
            errorDetails = await response.json();
          } catch {
            // ignore parse issues
          }
          const error = new Error(
            errorDetails?.error ||
              errorDetails?.detail ||
              errorDetails?.message ||
              `Request failed with status ${response.status}`
          );
          error.status = response.status;
          error.details = errorDetails;
          error.response = { data: errorDetails, status: response.status };
          error.endpoint = endpoint;
          throw error;
        }
        if (response.status === 204) {
          return null;
        }
        return response.json();
      } catch (err) {
        // Log detailed error for debugging
        console.error(`API Error [${method} ${endpoint}]:`, err);
        throw err;
      }
    },
    [fetchWithAuth]
  );

  // Memoize all API functions to prevent re-renders
  return useMemo(
    () => ({
    // Consent banners
    getBanners: () => request("/banners/"),
    createBanner: (payload) =>
      request("/banners/", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      }),
    updateBanner: (id, payload) =>
      request(`/banners/${id}/`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      }),
    deleteBanner: (id) =>
      request(`/banners/${id}/`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      }),

    // Consent logs
    getConsentLogs: (params = {}) =>
      request(`/logs/${buildQueryString(params)}`),

    // DSAR
    getDsarRequests: (params = {}) =>
      request(`/dsar/${buildQueryString(params)}`),
    createDsarRequest: (payload) =>
      request("/dsar/", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      }),
    updateDsarRequest: (id, payload) =>
      request(`/dsar/${id}/`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      }),
    deleteDsarRequest: (id) =>
      request(`/dsar/${id}/`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      }),

    // Data sources
    getDataSources: () => request("/data-sources/"),
    createDataSource: (payload) =>
      request("/data-sources/", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      }),
    updateDataSource: (id, payload) =>
      request(`/data-sources/${id}/`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      }),
    deleteDataSource: (id) =>
      request(`/data-sources/${id}/`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      }),

    // Masking policies

    // PII scans
    getPiiScans: () => request("/pii-scans/"),
    createPiiScan: (payload) =>
      request("/pii-scans/", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      }),
    markScanRunning: (id) =>
      request(`/pii-scans/${id}/mark_running/`, {
        method: "POST",
      }),
    markScanCompleted: (id, summary) =>
      request(`/pii-scans/${id}/mark_completed/`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ summary }),
      }),
    startScan: (id) =>
      request(`/pii-scans/${id}/start_scan/`, {
        method: "POST",
      }),
    deletePiiScan: (id) =>
      request(`/pii-scans/${id}/`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      }),

    // PII instances
    getPiiInstances: (params = {}) => {
      const queryString = buildQueryString(params);
      // buildQueryString returns "?param=value" or "", so we can append directly
      return request(`/pii-instances/${queryString}`);
    },

      // Test data source connection
      testDataSourceConnection: (id) =>
        request(`/data-sources/${id}/test_connection/`, {
          method: "POST",
        }),

      // Write-back masking (apply masking to source)
      writeBackMasking: (scanId, payload) =>
        request(`/pii-scans/${scanId}/write_back/`, {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify(payload),
        }),

      // Get masked text preview
      getMaskedPreview: (scanId, instanceIds, maskingMethod) =>
        request(`/pii-scans/${scanId}/preview_masking/`, {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            instance_ids: instanceIds,
            masking_method: maskingMethod,
          }),
        }),

      // Download masked report (CSV)
      downloadMaskedFile: async (scanId, instanceIds, maskingMethod, replacementText = null) => {
        const response = await fetchWithAuth(`${API_PREFIX}/pii-scans/${scanId}/download_masked/`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            instance_ids: instanceIds,
            masking_method: maskingMethod,
            replacement_text: replacementText,
          }),
        });
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("Failed to download masked report");
        }
        return response.blob();
      },

      // Preview document with highlighted PII
      previewDocument: (scanId) =>
        request(`/pii-scans/${scanId}/preview_document/`),

      // Download complete masked file (full original with PII masked)
      downloadFullMaskedFile: async (scanId, instanceIds, maskingMethod, replacementText = null) => {
        const response = await fetchWithAuth(`${API_PREFIX}/pii-scans/${scanId}/download_masked_file/`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            instance_ids: instanceIds || [],
            masking_method: maskingMethod,
            replacement_text: replacementText,
          }),
        });
        if (!response.ok) {
          const errorData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
          throw new Error(errorData.error || "Failed to download masked file");
        }
        return response.blob();
      },

      // Clear file cache for a scan
      clearScanFileCache: (scanId) =>
        request(`/pii-scans/${scanId}/clear_file_cache/`, {
          method: "POST",
        }),
    }),
    [request, fetchWithAuth]
  );
}
```

```javascriptreact
// src/DataSources.jsx
import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  FaPlus,
  FaDatabase,
  FaFileAlt,
  FaGlobe,
  FaCloud,
  FaTrash,
  FaCheckCircle,
  FaTimesCircle,
  FaPlug,
  FaEye,
  FaEyeSlash,
  FaLock,
  FaServer,
  FaInfoCircle,
  FaEdit,
} from "react-icons/fa";

export default function DataSources({
  onBack,
  dataSources = [],
  onAddSource,
  onUpdateSource,
  onDeleteSource,
  loading = false,
  onTestConnection,
}) {
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingSource, setEditingSource] = useState(null);
  const [testingConnection, setTestingConnection] = useState(false);
  const [testingSourceId, setTestingSourceId] = useState(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [formState, setFormState] = useState({
    sourceType: "",
    name: "",
    // Connection basics
    provider: "",
    databaseType: "",
    host: "",
    port: "",
    databaseName: "",
    region: "",
    // Authentication
    authMethod: "username_password",
    username: "",
    password: "",
    // Cloud-specific auth
    awsAccessKeyId: "",
    awsSecretAccessKey: "",
    awsRoleArn: "",
    azureTenantId: "",
    azureClientId: "",
    azureClientSecret: "",
    gcpServiceAccountJson: "",
    gcpProjectId: "",
    // SSH Tunnel
    sshHost: "",
    sshPort: "22",
    sshUsername: "",
    sshPassword: "",
    sshPrivateKey: "",
    // SSL/Security
    sslEnabled: true,
    sslMode: "require",
    caCertificate: "",
    clientCertificate: "",
    clientKey: "",
    connectionTimeout: "30",
    // Cloud-specific
    rdsInstanceId: "",
    vpcSecurityGroups: "",
    subnetGroup: "",
    // File storage specific
    bucketName: "",
    storageAccountName: "",
    containerName: "",
    endpointUrl: "",
    // Google Drive specific
    googleDriveClientId: "",
    googleDriveClientSecret: "",
    googleDriveRefreshToken: "",
    googleDriveFolderId: "",
    // Google Drive public URL mode
    googleDriveUsePublicUrl: true, // Default to simpler public URL mode
    googleDrivePublicUrl: "",
    googleDriveApiKey: "",
    // API specific
    baseUrl: "",
    apiKey: "",
    authType: "none",
    // Notes
    notes: "",
  });

  const safeSources = useMemo(
    () => (Array.isArray(dataSources) ? dataSources : []),
    [dataSources]
  );

  const getTypeIcon = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case "database":
        return FaDatabase;
      case "files":
        return FaFileAlt;
      case "api":
        return FaGlobe;
      case "cloud":
        return FaCloud;
      case "logs":
        return FaFileAlt;
      default:
        return FaDatabase;
    }
  };

  // Provider options based on source type
  const getProviderOptions = () => {
    switch (formState.sourceType) {
      case "database":
      case "cloud":
        return [
          { value: "aws_rds", label: "AWS RDS" },
          { value: "azure_sql", label: "Azure SQL Database" },
          { value: "gcp_cloud_sql", label: "Google Cloud SQL" },
          { value: "mongodb_atlas", label: "MongoDB Atlas" },
          { value: "self_hosted", label: "Self-Hosted (On-Premises)" },
          { value: "other", label: "Other" },
        ];
      case "files":
        return [
          { value: "aws_s3", label: "AWS S3" },
          { value: "azure_blob", label: "Azure Blob Storage" },
          { value: "gcp_storage", label: "Google Cloud Storage" },
          { value: "google_drive", label: "Google Drive" },
          { value: "sftp", label: "SFTP/FTP" },
          { value: "other", label: "Other" },
        ];
      case "api":
        return [
          { value: "rest_api", label: "REST API" },
          { value: "graphql", label: "GraphQL" },
          { value: "soap", label: "SOAP" },
          { value: "other", label: "Other" },
        ];
      case "logs":
        return [
          { value: "aws_cloudwatch", label: "AWS CloudWatch Logs" },
          { value: "azure_monitor", label: "Azure Monitor" },
          { value: "gcp_logging", label: "Google Cloud Logging" },
          { value: "splunk", label: "Splunk" },
          { value: "other", label: "Other" },
        ];
      default:
        return [];
    }
  };

  // Database type options
  const getDatabaseTypeOptions = () => {
    return [
      { value: "postgresql", label: "PostgreSQL" },
      { value: "mysql", label: "MySQL" },
      { value: "mariadb", label: "MariaDB" },
      { value: "sqlserver", label: "SQL Server" },
      { value: "oracle", label: "Oracle" },
      { value: "mongodb", label: "MongoDB" },
    ];
  };

  // Build connection details JSON from form state
  const buildConnectionDetails = () => {
    const details = {
      provider: formState.provider,
      source_type: formState.sourceType,
    };

    if (
      formState.sourceType === "database" ||
      formState.sourceType === "cloud"
    ) {
      details.database_type = formState.databaseType;
      details.connection = {
        host: formState.host,
        port: parseInt(formState.port) || undefined,
        database: formState.databaseName,
        region: formState.region || undefined,
      };

      // Authentication
      details.authentication = {
        method: formState.authMethod,
      };

      if (formState.authMethod === "username_password") {
        details.authentication.username = formState.username;
        details.authentication.password = formState.password; // Note: Should be encrypted in backend
      } else if (formState.authMethod === "certificate") {
        details.authentication.client_certificate = formState.clientCertificate;
        details.authentication.client_key = formState.clientKey; // Note: Should be encrypted in backend
      } else if (formState.authMethod === "iam") {
        if (formState.provider === "aws_rds") {
          details.authentication.aws_access_key_id = formState.awsAccessKeyId;
          details.authentication.aws_secret_access_key =
            formState.awsSecretAccessKey;
          details.authentication.aws_role_arn =
            formState.awsRoleArn || undefined;
        } else if (formState.provider === "azure_sql") {
          details.authentication.azure_tenant_id = formState.azureTenantId;
          details.authentication.azure_client_id = formState.azureClientId;
          details.authentication.azure_client_secret =
            formState.azureClientSecret;
        } else if (formState.provider === "gcp_cloud_sql") {
          details.authentication.gcp_project_id = formState.gcpProjectId;
          details.authentication.gcp_service_account_json =
            formState.gcpServiceAccountJson;
        }
      }

      // SSH Tunnel
      if (formState.authMethod === "ssh_tunnel") {
        details.ssh_tunnel = {
          host: formState.sshHost,
          port: parseInt(formState.sshPort) || 22,
          username: formState.sshUsername,
          password: formState.sshPassword || undefined,
          private_key: formState.sshPrivateKey || undefined,
        };
      }

      // Security/SSL
      if (formState.sslEnabled) {
        details.security = {
          ssl_enabled: true,
          ssl_mode: formState.sslMode,
          ca_certificate: formState.caCertificate || undefined,
          client_certificate: formState.clientCertificate || undefined,
          client_key: formState.clientKey || undefined,
          connection_timeout: parseInt(formState.connectionTimeout) || 30,
        };
      }

      // Cloud-specific
      if (formState.provider === "aws_rds") {
        details.cloud_specific = {
          rds_instance_id: formState.rdsInstanceId || undefined,
          vpc_security_groups: formState.vpcSecurityGroups
            ? formState.vpcSecurityGroups.split(",").map((sg) => sg.trim())
            : undefined,
          subnet_group: formState.subnetGroup || undefined,
        };
      }
    } else if (formState.sourceType === "files") {
      if (formState.provider === "aws_s3") {
        details.connection = {
          bucket_name: formState.bucketName,
          region: formState.region,
          endpoint_url: formState.endpointUrl || undefined,
        };
        details.authentication = {
          aws_access_key_id: formState.awsAccessKeyId,
          aws_secret_access_key: formState.awsSecretAccessKey,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "azure_blob") {
        details.connection = {
          storage_account_name: formState.storageAccountName,
          container_name: formState.containerName,
        };
        details.authentication = {
          azure_client_id: formState.azureClientId,
          azure_client_secret: formState.azureClientSecret,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "gcp_storage") {
        details.connection = {
          bucket_name: formState.bucketName,
          project_id: formState.gcpProjectId,
        };
        details.authentication = {
          gcp_service_account_json: formState.gcpServiceAccountJson,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "google_drive") {
        if (formState.googleDriveUsePublicUrl) {
          // Public URL mode (simpler)
          details.connection = {
            public_url: formState.googleDrivePublicUrl,
          };
          details.authentication = {
            api_key: formState.googleDriveApiKey || undefined,
          };
        } else {
          // OAuth mode
          details.connection = {
            folder_id: formState.googleDriveFolderId || undefined,
          };
          details.authentication = {
            client_id: formState.googleDriveClientId,
            client_secret: formState.googleDriveClientSecret,
            refresh_token: formState.googleDriveRefreshToken,
          };
        }
      } else if (formState.provider === "sftp") {
        details.connection = {
          host: formState.host,
          port: parseInt(formState.port) || 22,
          remote_path: formState.databaseName, // Reusing field for remote path
        };
        details.authentication = {
          username: formState.username,
          password: formState.password,
          private_key: formState.sshPrivateKey || undefined,
        };
      }
    } else if (formState.sourceType === "api") {
      details.connection = {
        base_url: formState.baseUrl,
      };
      details.authentication = {
        type: formState.authType,
        api_key: formState.apiKey || undefined,
        username: formState.username || undefined,
        password: formState.password || undefined,
      };
    } else if (formState.sourceType === "logs") {
      details.connection = {
        provider: formState.provider,
      };

      if (formState.provider === "aws_cloudwatch") {
        details.connection.log_group = formState.databaseName; // Log group name
        details.connection.region = formState.region || undefined;
        details.authentication = {
          aws_access_key_id: formState.awsAccessKeyId,
          aws_secret_access_key: formState.awsSecretAccessKey,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "azure_monitor") {
        details.connection.workspace_name = formState.databaseName; // Workspace name
        details.connection.resource_group = formState.region; // Resource group
        details.authentication = {
          azure_tenant_id: formState.azureTenantId,
          azure_client_id: formState.azureClientId,
          azure_client_secret: formState.azureClientSecret,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "gcp_logging") {
        details.connection.log_name = formState.databaseName; // Log name/filter
        details.connection.project_id = formState.gcpProjectId;
        details.authentication = {
          gcp_service_account_json: formState.gcpServiceAccountJson,
        };
      } else if (formState.provider === "splunk") {
        details.connection = {
          host: formState.host,
          port: parseInt(formState.port) || 8089,
          index: formState.databaseName, // Index name
        };
        details.authentication = {
          username: formState.username,
          password: formState.password,
        };
      }
    }

    return details;
  };

  const handleAddSource = async () => {
    if (!formState.sourceType || !formState.name) {
      alert("Please provide a name and source type.");
      return;
    }

    // Validate required fields based on source type
    if (
      (formState.sourceType === "database" ||
        formState.sourceType === "cloud") &&
      !formState.host
    ) {
      alert("Please provide a host/server address.");
      return;
    }

    if (formState.sourceType === "files") {
      if (!formState.provider) {
        alert("Please select a storage provider.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "aws_s3" &&
        (!formState.bucketName || !formState.region)
      ) {
        alert("Please provide bucket name and region for AWS S3.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "azure_blob" &&
        (!formState.storageAccountName || !formState.containerName)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide storage account name and container name for Azure Blob Storage."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "gcp_storage" &&
        (!formState.bucketName || !formState.gcpProjectId)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide bucket name and GCP project ID for Google Cloud Storage."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (formState.provider === "google_drive") {
        if (formState.googleDriveUsePublicUrl) {
          // Public URL mode validation
          if (!formState.googleDrivePublicUrl) {
            alert("Please provide the Google Drive public share URL.");
            return;
          }
          // Validate URL format
          if (!formState.googleDrivePublicUrl.includes("drive.google.com")) {
            alert("Please provide a valid Google Drive URL (e.g., https://drive.google.com/file/d/... or https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/...)");
            return;
          }
        } else {
          // OAuth mode validation
          if (
            !formState.googleDriveClientId ||
            !formState.googleDriveClientSecret ||
            !formState.googleDriveRefreshToken
          ) {
            alert(
              "Please provide Client ID, Client Secret, and Refresh Token for Google Drive."
            );
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "sftp" &&
        (!formState.host || !formState.databaseName)
      ) {
        alert("Please provide host and remote path for SFTP.");
        return;
      }
    }

    if (formState.sourceType === "api") {
      if (!formState.baseUrl) {
        alert("Please provide a base URL for the API.");
        return;
      }
      // Only validate auth if authentication is required
      if (formState.authType !== "none") {
        if (formState.authType === "api_key" && !formState.apiKey) {
          alert("Please provide an API key.");
          return;
        }
        if (
          formState.authType === "bearer_token" && !formState.apiKey
        ) {
          alert("Please provide a bearer token.");
          return;
        }
        if (
          formState.authType === "basic_auth" &&
          (!formState.username || !formState.password)
        ) {
          alert("Please provide username and password for basic authentication.");
          return;
        }
        if (formState.authType === "oauth") {
          alert("OAuth 2.0 authentication is not yet fully implemented. Please use API Key or Bearer Token instead.");
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    if (formState.sourceType === "logs") {
      if (!formState.provider) {
        alert("Please select a log provider.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "aws_cloudwatch" &&
        (!formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.region ||
          !formState.awsAccessKeyId ||
          !formState.awsSecretAccessKey)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide log group name, region, and AWS credentials for CloudWatch."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "azure_monitor" &&
        (!formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.region ||
          !formState.azureTenantId ||
          !formState.azureClientId ||
          !formState.azureClientSecret)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide workspace name, resource group, and Azure credentials for Azure Monitor."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "gcp_logging" &&
        (!formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.gcpProjectId ||
          !formState.gcpServiceAccountJson)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide log name/filter, project ID, and GCP service account JSON for Cloud Logging."
        );
        return;
      }
      if (
        formState.provider === "splunk" &&
        (!formState.host ||
          !formState.databaseName ||
          !formState.username ||
          !formState.password)
      ) {
        alert(
          "Please provide host, index name, username, and password for Splunk."
        );
        return;
      }
    }

    try {
      const connectionDetails = buildConnectionDetails();
      
      if (editingSource) {
        // Update existing source
        if (onUpdateSource) {
          await onUpdateSource(editingSource.id, {
            sourceType: formState.sourceType,
            name: formState.name,
            connectionDetails: connectionDetails,
            notes: formState.notes,
          });
        }
        setEditingSource(null);
      } else {
        // Create new source
        if (onAddSource) {
          await onAddSource({
            sourceType: formState.sourceType,
            name: formState.name,
            status: "connected",
            connectionDetails: connectionDetails,
            notes: formState.notes,
          });
        }
      }
      
      // Reset form
      setFormState({
        sourceType: "",
        name: "",
        provider: "",
        databaseType: "",
        host: "",
        port: "",
        databaseName: "",
        region: "",
        authMethod: "username_password",
        username: "",
        password: "",
        awsAccessKeyId: "",
        awsSecretAccessKey: "",
        awsRoleArn: "",
        azureTenantId: "",
        azureClientId: "",
        azureClientSecret: "",
        gcpServiceAccountJson: "",
        gcpProjectId: "",
        sshHost: "",
        sshPort: "22",
        sshUsername: "",
        sshPassword: "",
        sshPrivateKey: "",
        sslEnabled: true,
        sslMode: "require",
        caCertificate: "",
        clientCertificate: "",
        clientKey: "",
        connectionTimeout: "30",
        rdsInstanceId: "",
        vpcSecurityGroups: "",
        subnetGroup: "",
        bucketName: "",
        storageAccountName: "",
        containerName: "",
        endpointUrl: "",
        googleDriveClientId: "",
        googleDriveClientSecret: "",
        googleDriveRefreshToken: "",
        googleDriveFolderId: "",
        googleDriveUsePublicUrl: true,
        googleDrivePublicUrl: "",
        googleDriveApiKey: "",
        baseUrl: "",
        apiKey: "",
        authType: "none",
        notes: "",
      });
      setShowAddModal(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to save data source", err);
      alert(`Unable to ${editingSource ? 'update' : 'add'} data source. Please try again.`);
    }
  };

  const handleTestConnection = async () => {
    if (!formState.sourceType) {
      alert("Please select a source type before testing connection.");
      return;
    }

    // Validate required fields based on source type
    if (formState.sourceType === "api" && !formState.baseUrl) {
      alert("Please provide a base URL for the API.");
      return;
    }
    if (
      (formState.sourceType === "database" || formState.sourceType === "cloud") &&
      !formState.host
    ) {
      alert("Please provide a host/server address.");
      return;
    }
    if (formState.sourceType === "files" && !formState.provider) {
      alert("Please select a storage provider.");
      return;
    }
    if (formState.sourceType === "logs" && !formState.provider) {
      alert("Please select a log provider.");
      return;
    }

    setTestingConnection(true);
    try {
      const connectionDetails = buildConnectionDetails();
      if (onTestConnection) {
        const result = await onTestConnection({
          sourceType: formState.sourceType,
          name: formState.name || `Test ${formState.sourceType}`,
          connectionDetails: connectionDetails,
        });
        
        // Handle different response formats (same as handleTestConnectionFromCard)
        if (result) {
          if (result.status === "success" || result.status === "ok") {
            const message = result.message || "Connection test successful!";
            alert(`✅ Connection test successful!\n${message}`);
          } else if (result.status === "error" || result.status === "failed") {
            const errorMsg = result.error || result.message || "Connection test failed";
            alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n${errorMsg}`);
          } else {
            // If no status field, check for success field
            if (result.success) {
              alert(`✅ Connection test successful!\n${result.message || ""}`);
            } else {
              alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n${result.error || result.message || "Unknown error"}`);
            }
          }
        } else {
          alert(`✅ Connection test completed`);
        }
      } else {
        // Fallback - just show alert
        alert(
          "Connection testing will be available after configuration is saved."
        );
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Connection test error", err);
      console.error("Full error response:", err?.response);
      console.error("Error response data:", err?.response?.data);
      
      // Try to extract detailed error message from response
      let errorMsg = "Unknown error occurred";
      
      try {
        if (err?.response?.data) {
          const errorData = err.response.data;
          errorMsg = errorData.error || errorData.message || errorData.detail || JSON.stringify(errorData);
        } else if (err?.message) {
          errorMsg = err.message;
        }
      } catch (parseErr) {
        console.error("Error parsing error response:", parseErr);
        errorMsg = err?.message || "Failed to parse error response";
      }
      
      alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n\n${errorMsg}\n\nCheck browser console for detailed error information.`);
    } finally {
      setTestingConnection(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTestConnectionFromCard = async (source) => {
    if (!onTestConnection || !source.id) {
      alert("Unable to test connection. Source ID is missing.");
      return;
    }

    setTestingSourceId(source.id);
    try {
      const result = await onTestConnection(source.id);
      
      // Handle different response formats
      if (result) {
        if (result.status === "success" || result.status === "ok") {
          const message = result.message || `Connection to ${source.name} is working!`;
          alert(`✅ Connection test successful!\n${message}`);
        } else if (result.status === "error" || result.status === "failed") {
          const errorMsg = result.error || result.message || "Connection test failed";
          alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n${errorMsg}`);
        } else {
          // If no status field, assume success if we got a response
          alert(`✅ Connection test completed for ${source.name}`);
        }
      } else {
        alert(`✅ Connection test completed for ${source.name}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Connection test error", err);
      console.error("Full error response:", err?.response);
      console.error("Error response data:", err?.response?.data);
      console.error("Error details:", err?.details);
      
      // Try to extract detailed error message from response
      let errorMsg = "Unknown error occurred";
      
      try {
        if (err?.response?.data) {
          const errorData = err.response.data;
          errorMsg = errorData.error || errorData.message || errorData.detail || JSON.stringify(errorData);
        } else if (err?.details) {
          errorMsg = err.details.error || err.details.message || err.details.detail || JSON.stringify(err.details);
        } else if (err?.message) {
          errorMsg = err.message;
        }
      } catch (parseErr) {
        console.error("Error parsing error response:", parseErr);
        errorMsg = err?.message || "Failed to parse error response";
      }
      
      alert(`❌ Connection test failed:\n\n${errorMsg}\n\nCheck browser console for detailed error information.`);
    } finally {
      setTestingSourceId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleEdit = (source) => {
    const details = source.connectionDetails || {};
    const connection = details.connection || {};
    const auth = details.authentication || {};
    const security = details.security || {};
    const sshTunnel = details.ssh_tunnel || {};
    const cloudSpecific = details.cloud_specific || {};

    // Populate form with existing data
    setFormState({
      sourceType: source.sourceType || "",
      name: source.name || "",
      provider: details.provider || "",
      databaseType: connection.database_type || "",
      host: connection.host || "",
      port: connection.port?.toString() || "",
      databaseName: connection.database || "",
      region: connection.region || "",
      authMethod: auth.method || "username_password",
      username: auth.username || "",
      password: auth.password || "",
      awsAccessKeyId: auth.aws_access_key_id || "",
      awsSecretAccessKey: auth.aws_secret_access_key || "",
      awsRoleArn: auth.aws_role_arn || "",
      azureTenantId: auth.azure_tenant_id || "",
      azureClientId: auth.azure_client_id || "",
      azureClientSecret: auth.azure_client_secret || "",
      gcpServiceAccountJson: auth.gcp_service_account_json || "",
      gcpProjectId: auth.gcp_project_id || connection.project_id || "",
      sshHost: sshTunnel.host || "",
      sshPort: sshTunnel.port?.toString() || "22",
      sshUsername: sshTunnel.username || "",
      sshPassword: sshTunnel.password || "",
      sshPrivateKey: sshTunnel.private_key || "",
      sslEnabled: security.ssl_enabled !== false,
      sslMode: security.ssl_mode || "require",
      caCertificate: security.ca_certificate || "",
      clientCertificate: security.client_certificate || "",
      clientKey: security.client_key || "",
      connectionTimeout: security.connection_timeout?.toString() || "30",
      rdsInstanceId: cloudSpecific.rds_instance_id || "",
      vpcSecurityGroups: cloudSpecific.vpc_security_groups?.join(", ") || "",
      subnetGroup: cloudSpecific.subnet_group || "",
      bucketName: connection.bucket_name || "",
      storageAccountName: connection.storage_account_name || "",
      containerName: connection.container_name || "",
      endpointUrl: connection.endpoint_url || "",
      // Google Drive specific
      googleDriveClientId: auth.client_id || "",
      googleDriveClientSecret: auth.client_secret || "",
      googleDriveRefreshToken: auth.refresh_token || "",
      googleDriveFolderId: connection.folder_id || "",
      googleDriveUsePublicUrl: !!connection.public_url,
      googleDrivePublicUrl: connection.public_url || "",
      googleDriveApiKey: auth.api_key || "",
      // API specific
      baseUrl: connection.base_url || "",
      apiKey: auth.api_key || "",
      authType: auth.type || "none",
      // Notes
      notes: source.notes || "",
    });

    setEditingSource(source);
    setShowAddModal(true);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {

    ) {
      return;

    try {
      await onDeleteSource(id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to delete data source", err);
      alert("Unable to delete data source. Please try again.");
    }
  };
```
